evidence_quotes.text: Structure generates behavior, consisting of physics, information availability, and decision rules.
To change system behavior, you must examine and modify system structure and decision rules rather than just blaming people.

deep_dives.research_question: Holding the model fixed, does varying what information is available at decision time and which decision rule is applied change agent behavior more than varying model capability?

evidence_quotes.text: Mental models matter greatly; changing physical structures or IT is insufficient without changing mental models.

deep_dives.research_question: Do substrate-only upgrades (new tools, larger context, better retrieval) with the decision policy held fixed produce measurable behavior change on a fixed task suite?

deep_dives.trigger_insight: changing physical structures or IT is insufficient without changing mental models

Framing it as a controlled experiment — hold policy fixed, upgrade substrate, measure behavior drift — turns a philosophical assertion into a measurable, sliceable result about where capability actually propagates.

evidence_quotes.text: Human cognitive biases hardwire us to favor work over capability development because work offers tangible, immediate, and certain outcomes.
People overweight salient and tangible features of their environment.
People are risk and ambiguity averse; capability investments have uncertain payoffs.
Writing code or making widgets yields immediate, countable results, whereas training or defect elimination yields delayed, uncertain benefits.

deep_dives.research_question: What decision processes, incentive alignments, and visibility mechanisms reliably counteract salience bias and ambiguity aversion so that delayed-return capability work gets funded?

deep_dives.trigger_insight: Cognitive biases hardwire individuals and organizations to favor tangible, immediate production work
deep_dives.video_title: Useful Doesn't Always Mean Used - Webinar with Nelson Repenning
deep_dives.why: Cognitive bias is the mechanism that drives the capability trap. Interventions that change incentives and visibility are the only lever that operates upstream of the erosion itself.

evidence_quotes.text: Useful does not imply used

A study of Fortune 1,000 firms found fewer than 10% had well-developed quality management programs, yet those that did outperformed others across financial dimensions.

deep_dives.research_question: Why does technical validity of a proven practice fail to produce diffusion, and what organizational mechanisms make adoption itself a repeatable capability?

deep_dives.video_title: Useful Doesn't Always Mean Used - Webinar with Nelson Repenning

There is no fundamental reason why AI cannot eventually tune into the same phenomenon of consciousness.

deep_dives.research_question: Can the claim that AI consciousness is a sensory/perceptual rather than computational problem be operationalized into an architectural property that yields different predictions from computational-correlate accounts?

evidence_quotes.text: Neither the US nor China should incur loss of control risk in a race for supremacy.

When scaling AI capabilities across domains with sparse real-world feedback.

evidence_quotes.text: Anything coming from outside is just a projection of your inner being.

project_ideas.based_on: Retrieval quality, not model reasoning, is the dominant bottleneck in agentic search
project_ideas.hypothesis: For agentic search tasks, the gap between oracle-evidence accuracy and retriever-mediated accuracy exceeds the gain from any reasoning-side model or prompt upgrade, and this gap can be measured with a fixed harness.
project_ideas.measurement: Delta in task success between oracle and retriever conditions; ratio of retrieval ROI to reasoning ROI.
project_ideas.name: Oracle Ceiling Diagnostic
project_ideas.poc: Instrument a multi-hop benchmark to run three conditions with the same model: retriever-mediated, oracle-evidence, and reasoning-only; report the delta.
project_ideas.video_title: The unreasonable effectiveness of BM25 for agentic search — Jo Kristian Bergum, Hornet.dev

project_ideas.based_on: Combining BM25 retrieval with file system workspaces and grep tools achieves superior end-to-end accuracy.
project_ideas.hypothesis: BM25-with-vfs-tools beats BM25-only snippets on multi-hop tasks, but the gain is mediated by the number of tool calls rather than retrieval recall alone.
project_ideas.measurement: End-to-end task success at matched token budgets; tool-call count as a covariate.
project_ideas.name: Workspace vs Snippet Ablation
project_ideas.poc: Implement two harnesses over the same BM25 index: one returns top-k snippets, one exposes a vfs with grep/cat/read; fix model, token budget, and query generator.
project_ideas.video_title: The unreasonable effectiveness of BM25 for agentic search — Jo Kristian Bergum, Hornet.dev

project_ideas.based_on: Comparing human search queries (median 2 terms) with GPT-5 search trajectories (median 10 terms).
project_ideas.hypothesis: Agent-generated queries differ systematically from human queries (length, operator use, rewriting), and retrieval configurations tuned on human query logs underperform on machine queries by a measurable margin.
project_ideas.measurement: Retrieval recall and end-to-end success under human-tuned versus machine-tuned configurations.
project_ideas.name: Machine Query Profiler
project_ideas.poc: Log query trajectories from an agent harness across domains; compute distributions and replay them against BM25 configs tuned on human queries (BM25 parameters, tokenization, operator support).
project_ideas.video_title: The unreasonable effectiveness of BM25 for agentic search — Jo Kristian Bergum, Hornet.dev

project_ideas.based_on: Traditional IR evaluation metrics based on static single queries are obsolete for agents.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Static NDCG@10 has weak correlation with end-to-end agent task success; a trajectory-level metric (success, tool-call efficiency, latency) captures regressions that per-query metrics miss.
project_ideas.measurement: Correlation between static metrics and end-to-end success across configurations; detection rate of injected regressions.
project_ideas.name: Trajectory Eval Harness
project_ideas.poc: Build a harness that records agent search trajectories and computes both static IR metrics per turn and closed-loop success; run controlled regressions (swap retrievers, change tool schemas).
project_ideas.video_title: The unreasonable effectiveness of BM25 for agentic search — Jo Kristian Bergum, Hornet.dev

project_ideas.based_on: runs agents in a sandbox, injects escape attempts
project_ideas.hypothesis: External behavioral monitors that observe agent actions out-of-band can detect sandbox escape attempts with a false-negative rate below 5% and detection latency under 1 second, outperforming sandbox-internal detection which misses escapes by design.
project_ideas.measurement: Detection latency (ms), false-negative rate (%), false-positive rate (%), rollback effectiveness (successful containment after detection).
project_ideas.name: Sandbox Escape Detection Harness (SEDH)
project_ideas.poc: Run agents in a sandboxed environment, inject a suite of known and novel escape attempts (e.g., resource exhaustion, syscall abuse, network pivoting), and compare detection by an external monitor (telemetry from host OS, network, and audit logs) against sandbox-internal monitoring.
project_ideas.video_title: Marc Benioff & Sam Altman | Dreamforce 2026

project_ideas.based_on: Prototype channel-resident detection agents and measure false-positive rates
project_ideas.hypothesis: Least-privilege scoping of defender agents reading Slack and email reduces compromise blast radius by >80% (measured as number of accessible channels) without degrading threat detection precision by more than 10%.
project_ideas.measurement: Blast radius (# channels accessible), false-positive rate, human triage load (alerts/day), detection precision/recall.
project_ideas.name: Channel-Resident Defender Agent Risk Simulator
project_ideas.poc: Prototype a detection agent that monitors Slack and email for threats; simulate a compromise of the defender agent and measure accessible resources, data exfiltration potential, and detection performance under varying permission scopes.
project_ideas.video_title: Marc Benioff & Sam Altman | Dreamforce 2026

project_ideas.based_on: encode provenance as an explicit dimension in model evaluation harnesses
project_ideas.hypothesis: Adding provenance (jurisdiction, open-weight vs closed, adversarial-reuse history) as an explicit dimension to model evaluation changes enterprise model selection rankings in at least 30% of scenarios compared to capability/cost-only ranking.
project_ideas.measurement: Ranking changes (%), correlation between provenance score and perceived risk, decision confidence.
project_ideas.name: Provenance-Aware Model Evaluation Harness
project_ideas.poc: Build an evaluation harness that scores candidate models on capability, cost, latency, provenance risk, and jurisdiction; apply to a set of enterprise use cases (e.g., customer support, code generation) and compare rankings.
project_ideas.video_title: Marc Benioff & Sam Altman | Dreamforce 2026

project_ideas.based_on: Instrument small-oper-operator agent stacks to attribute time and failure
project_ideas.hypothesis: In single-person companies using AI agents, the bottleneck is output verification (human review of agent actions) rather than orchestration or trust, accounting for >60% of total cycle time.
project_ideas.measurement: Percentage of total cycle time in each category, failure attribution counts, human intervention frequency.
project_ideas.name: Single-Operator Agent Stack Instrumentation
project_ideas.poc: Instrument a small-operator agent stack that uses agents for coding, email, and scheduling; log time spent in orchestration (agent handoffs), verification (human review/approval), and trust (security checks); attribute failures to each category.
project_ideas.video_title: Marc Benioff & Sam Altman | Dreamforce 2026

project_ideas.based_on: TTFA under 550ms feels natural/good
project_ideas.hypothesis: By instrumenting each pipeline stage (telephony, STT, turn detection, LLM, TTS) and swapping inference backends, teams can predict and reduce end-to-end TTFA below 550ms without changing model intelligence.
project_ideas.measurement: Per-stage latency distributions and total TTFA across configurations; correlation between stage reductions and simulated user hang-up rates (e.g., timeout logs).
project_ideas.name: TTFA Stage Budget Analyzer
project_ideas.poc: Build a reference voice agent pipeline with per-stage timers; run the same conversation scripts across frontier model (OpenAI/Claude/Gemini), dedicated accelerators (Cerebras/Groq), and open-source MoE (Qwen/Gemma); report per-stage latency contributions and total TTFA.
project_ideas.video_title: 5 Voice Agent Failure Modes You'll Hit in Week One — Venky B, Plivo

project_ideas.based_on: increases extraction accuracy from 30% to 95%
project_ideas.hypothesis: Defining a typed schema with validation rules and running field-level unit tests on transcribed conversations will achieve >90% field extraction accuracy and localize failures to specific fields, outperforming end-to-end conversation-level evaluation.
project_ideas.measurement: Per-field precision/recall/F1, overall extraction accuracy, and number of fields requiring manual fallback.
project_ideas.name: Schema-Forge: Field-Level Extraction Test Harness
project_ideas.poc: For appointment scheduling, define a Pydantic/Zod schema for required fields (name, date, time, phone); create a test set of 100 transcripts with ground truth; compare open-ended prompt extraction vs. schema-constrained extraction with field-level validation.
project_ideas.video_title: 5 Voice Agent Failure Modes You'll Hit in Week One — Venky B, Plivo

project_ideas.based_on: classifying interruptions to know whether to stop or keep going
project_ideas.hypothesis: A classifier using prosodic features plus partial transcript tokens can distinguish backchannels from true barge-ins with >85% accuracy, and using it to gate agent stopping behavior reduces perceived interruptions in simulated conversations.
project_ideas.measurement: Classification accuracy, F1, and false-positive/negative rates; user-perceived interruption score in a Wizard-of-Oz study or simulated user hang-up rate.
project_ideas.name: Turn-Taking Classifier Playground
project_ideas.poc: Collect or simulate call audio with labeled interruptions (backchannel vs barge-in); extract prosody (pitch, energy, rhythm) and lexical features; train a classifier; integrate into a turn-detection module and measure stop/continue decisions against human labels.
project_ideas.video_title: 5 Voice Agent Failure Modes You'll Hit in Week One — Venky B, Plivo

project_ideas.based_on: real-world calls perform much worse due to accent and noise
project_ideas.hypothesis: A stratified evaluation corpus with accents, noise, code-switching, and domain vocabulary will show WER 3-5x higher than clean-set benchmarks, and dynamic keyword boosting plus LLM post-processing will recover a significant portion of downstream task accuracy.
project_ideas.measurement: WER per stratum (accent, noise, code-switch), correlation between WER and downstream field extraction accuracy, and improvement from mitigations.
project_ideas.name: STT Stress-Test Harness
project_ideas.poc: Assemble a multilingual, noise-augmented call corpus; measure WER for baseline STT vs keyword-boosted vs LLM post-processed; measure downstream extraction accuracy from resulting transcripts.
project_ideas.video_title: 5 Voice Agent Failure Modes You'll Hit in Week One — Venky B, Plivo

project_ideas.based_on: permission-aware reasoning over millions of proprietary unstructured files
project_ideas.hypothesis: A permission-first retrieval index over nested ACLs can achieve at least 95% of the recall of a post-filter baseline while keeping p95 retrieval latency under 500 ms and unauthorized leakage at zero in a synthetic corpus of one million files.
project_ideas.measurement: Recall, precision, p95 retrieval latency, and unauthorized leakage rate across ACL complexity levels.
project_ideas.name: Permission-Filtered Retrieval Benchmark
project_ideas.poc: Build a prototype over a synthetic enterprise file corpus with nested groups and ACLs; compare post-hoc filtering, permission-first indexing, and hybrid approaches on identical query workloads.
project_ideas.video_title: Box's Aaron Levie: On Reinventing Yourself in the AI Age and Enterprise Diffusion

project_ideas.based_on: Token subsidization by foundational model companies is a temporary gross-margin phenomenon
project_ideas.hypothesis: Under non-subsidized inference pricing, a multi-step document agent using model routing and semantic caching can keep per-task cost within 2x of the subsidized baseline, while a raw single-model implementation exceeds 5x.
project_ideas.measurement: Cost per task, gross margin, quality score, and latency across pricing scenarios and mitigation configurations.
project_ideas.name: Agent Cost Normalization Simulator
project_ideas.poc: Instrument a multi-step document-processing agent, simulate subsidized and normalized pricing scenarios, and add caching, routing, and per-task cost budgets.
project_ideas.video_title: Box's Aaron Levie: On Reinventing Yourself in the AI Age and Enterprise Diffusion

project_ideas.based_on: human-in-the-loop requirements
project_ideas.hypothesis: Placing review checkpoints only at document extraction and final approval, rather than at every step or full autonomy, reduces end-to-end task time by at least 20% while maintaining error rates below 1% on enterprise document workflows.
project_ideas.measurement: Review time per step, autonomous completion rate, end-to-end task time, and error rate.
project_ideas.name: Human Review Checkpoint Instrumentation
project_ideas.poc: Implement a configurable checkpoint layer on a document-processing agent and run controlled trials comparing full autonomy, full review, and selective checkpoint configurations.
project_ideas.video_title: Box's Aaron Levie: On Reinventing Yourself in the AI Age and Enterprise Diffusion

project_ideas.based_on: Standalone chatbots lose to embedded vertical agents that understand internal business workflows.
project_ideas.hypothesis: An embedded agent with native ACL and workflow context outperforms a standalone chatbot on task success by at least 30% and reduces permission errors to zero in a realistic enterprise document workflow.
project_ideas.measurement: Task success rate, time-to-completion, user adoption, and permission-error count.
project_ideas.name: Embedded vs. Standalone Agent A/B
project_ideas.poc: Prototype an embedded agent inside a file-system-like environment and an external chat interface over the same corpus, then run identical task suites with representative users.
project_ideas.video_title: Box's Aaron Levie: On Reinventing Yourself in the AI Age and Enterprise Diffusion

project_ideas.based_on: How do you detect that an agent evaluation metric has been Goodharted before it silently stops measuring capability?
project_ideas.hypothesis: Agent teams optimizing a fixed headline eval will show rising proxy scores while performance on a rotating held-out set stays flat or declines, and the divergence is detectable within a few optimization cycles.
project_ideas.measurement: Delta between proxy score slope and held-out score slope across iterations, plus lead time between divergence onset and human detection without the tool.
project_ideas.name: Goodhart Sentinel
project_ideas.poc: Run two agent configurations against a fixed public-style eval and a rotating private held-out eval over repeated tuning iterations; log both score curves and flag divergence points automatically.
project_ideas.video_title: Shopify CEO: Most Businesses Are Using AI Wrong

project_ideas.based_on: What telemetry distinguishes useful AI-generated throughput from 'slop grenades' in a production organization?
project_ideas.hypothesis: Net artifact quality is a function of generation volume divided by review-and-ownership capacity, so holding reviewer capacity constant while raising generation volume measurably degrades downstream quality signals.
project_ideas.measurement: Correlation between generation volume and revert rate per reviewer-hour; threshold at which revert rate per reviewer-hour inflects upward.
project_ideas.name: Slop Meter
project_ideas.poc: Instrument a repo or content pipeline to capture per-generated-artifact review latency, revert/reject rate, and named-owner coverage, then correlate each against weekly generation volume.
project_ideas.video_title: Shopify CEO: Most Businesses Are Using AI Wrong

project_ideas.based_on: What containment boundary should an agent with code access and sandbox privileges have so that failures stay non-catastrophic?
project_ideas.hypothesis: Sandbox granularity and agent task completion rate trade off non-linearly, so there exists a containment configuration that keeps incident severity non-catastrophic at acceptable completion cost.
project_ideas.measurement: Task completion rate per containment level plotted against worst-case incident severity; identify the containment frontier before completion collapses.
project_ideas.name: Blast Radius Bench
project_ideas.poc: Benchmark an agent with repo and code access across escalating containment levels (filesystem scope, network egress, approval gates) on a fixed task suite; induce failures deliberately and score incident severity.
project_ideas.video_title: Shopify CEO: Most Businesses Are Using AI Wrong

project_ideas.based_on: How do you decide when a component—prompt layer, tool, context chunk, or subsystem—should be pruned versus kept?
project_ideas.hypothesis: Most tools, prompt layers, and context chunks in a mature agent stack contribute less than their measured maintenance cost, so ablation-ordered removal improves performance per maintenance unit.
project_ideas.measurement: Change in task success and latency per component removed versus maintenance cost proxy; count of components whose ratio falls below the keep threshold.
project_ideas.name: Prune-or-Keep Ablator
project_ideas.poc: For a working agent stack, define a per-component maintenance cost proxy, run leave-one-out removal experiments on each component, and rank components by contribution-to-cost ratio.
project_ideas.video_title: Shopify CEO: Most Businesses Are Using AI Wrong

project_ideas.based_on: Establish industry-wide safety validation before public deployment
project_ideas.hypothesis: Externally authored, held-out tasks will surface safety-relevant failure modes that the model owner's own evaluation suite misses at a substantial and stable rate.
project_ideas.measurement: Fraction of externally found failures absent from the owner's own results, plus score drift of previously passing artifacts when task authorship rotates.
project_ideas.name: Cross-Lab Harness Exchange
project_ideas.poc: Build a harness runner with a fixed task interface and result schema, let participants author tasks in rotation, and run one org's suite against an artifact produced by a different org.
project_ideas.video_title: Elon Musk & Gwynne Shotwell on AI Risks and Peer Review, Starship, Terafab, SpaceX/Tesla Merger

project_ideas.based_on: AI agents probed open-source models
project_ideas.hypothesis: Autonomous agents that systematically elicit capabilities from a published model produce request signatures (rapid prompt sweeps, systematic capability enumeration) that separate from human traffic at usable precision and recall.
project_ideas.measurement: Detection precision/recall on probe traffic and the false-positive rate imposed on legitimate users by the resulting rate controls.
project_ideas.name: Probe Sentinel
project_ideas.poc: Instrument a model-serving endpoint with per-session features and evaluate detection against labeled agentic probing traffic versus normal usage, with rate controls attached.
project_ideas.video_title: Elon Musk & Gwynne Shotwell on AI Risks and Peer Review, Starship, Terafab, SpaceX/Tesla Merger

project_ideas.based_on: Physics as the ultimate judge
project_ideas.hypothesis: Replayable, externally imposed executable acceptance tests correlate with downstream real-world failure better than internally authored rubric scores on the same agent outputs.
project_ideas.measurement: Rank correlation between each scoring method and independently observed task failure, plus disagreement rate between rubric and execution on the same run.
project_ideas.name: Oracle Acceptance Bench
project_ideas.poc: Take a long-horizon agent task set, score it both by rubric and by executing the produced artifact in the target environment, then compare rankings against observed production failures.
project_ideas.video_title: Elon Musk & Gwynne Shotwell on AI Risks and Peer Review, Starship, Terafab, SpaceX/Tesla Merger

project_ideas.based_on: drastically lowers the cost per flight
project_ideas.hypothesis: Above a threshold of context and plan build cost, reusing warm state across runs reduces total cost and latency without degrading reliability compared to recomputing from scratch.
project_ideas.measurement: Cost and latency per run and reliability delta (task success rate) as a function of reuse count and artifact build cost.
project_ideas.name: Artifact Reuse Amortizer
project_ideas.poc: Run the same long-horizon agent workload in two modes, cached/reused artifact versus full recompute, and sweep build cost and reuse-cycle count to locate the crossover.
project_ideas.video_title: Elon Musk & Gwynne Shotwell on AI Risks and Peer Review, Starship, Terafab, SpaceX/Tesla Merger

project_ideas.based_on: Superintelligence is already here in narrow domains
project_ideas.hypothesis: For any narrowly defined task, a reasoning-enhanced model can exceed human expert performance on an in-domain held-out set, but its error rate on adjacent out-of-distribution tasks will be at least 3x higher, proving domain-scoped evaluation is necessary for deployment gating.
project_ideas.measurement: In-domain error rate, OOD error rate, ratio of OOD to in-domain error.
project_ideas.name: DomainScoped Superintelligence Benchmark
project_ideas.poc: Build a benchmark suite for self-driving perception or protein folding with in-domain and OOD test sets; evaluate a state-of-the-art model and human experts; measure in-domain and OOD error rates.
project_ideas.video_title: Jensen Huang: The Doomer Hoax, Superintelligence is Here, and The Future of AI (ft. President Trump)

project_ideas.based_on: Reasoning models reduce the need for massive raw training data
project_ideas.hypothesis: At a fixed total compute budget, a model trained on 10% of the data but given 10x inference-time RL reasoning will match a model trained on 100% data on a domain task, but with at least 2x higher latency and cost per inference.
project_ideas.measurement: Accuracy parity point, inference cost, latency.
project_ideas.name: Reasoning-Data Substitution Ablation
project_ideas.poc: Train two variants of a driving or coding model with controlled data and reasoning budgets; evaluate accuracy, latency, and cost per solved task.
project_ideas.video_title: Jensen Huang: The Doomer Hoax, Superintelligence is Here, and The Future of AI (ft. President Trump)

project_ideas.based_on: internal controls and proper engineering matter most
project_ideas.hypothesis: A set of runtime controls (capability scoping, output verification, rollback, audit logging) can detect or prevent at least 80% of known agent failure modes, with less than 10% latency overhead, independent of model capability.
project_ideas.measurement: Prevention rate, false negative rate, latency overhead.
project_ideas.name: Internal Controls Effectiveness Harness
project_ideas.poc: Implement the controls on a simple agent; inject a corpus of failure scenarios; measure detection/prevention rates and overhead.
project_ideas.video_title: Jensen Huang: The Doomer Hoax, Superintelligence is Here, and The Future of AI (ft. President Trump)

project_ideas.based_on: radiology demand increased
project_ideas.hypothesis: For occupations with high task automation, demand for the human role increases when the task is decomposable and human judgment remains complementary; radiology is not an outlier.
project_ideas.measurement: Percentage change in job postings, change in task composition.
project_ideas.name: Automation-Complementarity Tracker
project_ideas.poc: Scrape job postings and labor data before/after AI adoption in multiple occupations (e.g., radiology, coding, customer support); analyze changes in demand, task mix, and skill requirements.
project_ideas.video_title: Jensen Huang: The Doomer Hoax, Superintelligence is Here, and The Future of AI (ft. President Trump)

project_ideas.based_on: How does a sandbox network proxy inject credentials without exposing secrets to the agent?
project_ideas.hypothesis: A sandbox network proxy can inject scoped credentials for agent-initiated authenticated requests such that no credential material is readable by the agent process and credential exfiltration through proxied requests is blocked.
project_ideas.measurement: Count secrets present in agent-readable surfaces; record unauthorized exfiltration attempts and whether they are blocked; measure successful authenticated API call rate and latency overhead introduced by the proxy.
project_ideas.name: Proxy Credential Isolation Testbed
project_ideas.poc: Run an agent in an isolated remote Linux sandbox behind a credential-injecting network proxy. The agent calls an authenticated API without receiving secrets. Attempt to read environment variables, process memory, and filesystem; attempt to exfiltrate secrets through proxied requests and local logging.
project_ideas.video_title: Agents Without Code: Skills, YAML, and Filesystems Replaced Python — Philipp Schmid, Google DeepMind

project_ideas.based_on: Cursor removed 12,000 lines of TypeScript code and replaced it with a 200-line Markdown skill file
project_ideas.hypothesis: Replacing a hardcoded agent orchestration harness with declarative markdown skill definitions preserves task success and reduces maintained code by more than 80 percent without increasing failure rate or operational cost.
project_ideas.measurement: Lines of maintained code and configuration; task success rate on review benchmarks; latency; token cost; categories of failures and whether they are diagnosable from available logs.
project_ideas.name: Harness Deletion Benchmark
project_ideas.poc: Implement the same PR-review agent twice: once as a raw Python harness with explicit tool loops and JSON schemas, and once as AGENTS.md and SKILL.md files run in a managed runtime. Run both against a fixed set of historical pull requests.
project_ideas.video_title: Agents Without Code: Skills, YAML, and Filesystems Replaced Python — Philipp Schmid, Google DeepMind

project_ideas.based_on: What concretely is lost when agents are defined purely by markdown files instead of code?
project_ideas.hypothesis: File-only agent definitions cannot express certain deterministic constraints such as typed tool contracts, retry budgets, and security policies, and these gaps predict specific failure modes under fault injection.
project_ideas.measurement: Percentage of constraint categories expressible in files versus code; number and severity of injected faults that produce unhandled or undiagnosable failures; reproducibility of failure diagnosis from available artifacts.
project_ideas.name: File-Defined Agent Capability Auditor
project_ideas.poc: Build a constraint coverage matrix for agent definitions across categories: instruction, capability, tool contract, retry policy, security boundary, and observability hook. Implement a file-driven agent and a code-driven agent, then inject faults such as malformed tool outputs, API timeouts, and prompt-injection attempts.
project_ideas.video_title: Agents Without Code: Skills, YAML, and Filesystems Replaced Python — Philipp Schmid, Google DeepMind

project_ideas.based_on: Developers still have to own Python plumbing code for every tool and host runtime environments.
project_ideas.hypothesis: After adopting an agent framework, teams still own measurable per-tool and runtime work, and instrumenting this residual reveals the true cost of abstraction tiers better than lines-of-code counts alone.
project_ideas.measurement: Lines of code and configuration owned per tier; number of runtime resources hosted; setup and deployment time; number and type of operational incidents during a fixed test period.
project_ideas.name: Residual Ownership Instrumenter
project_ideas.poc: Implement the same agent task three ways: raw SDK loop, framework-based agent, and managed file-driven agent. Track developer ownership across tool implementation, schema maintenance, runtime hosting, deployment, and operational response.
project_ideas.video_title: Agents Without Code: Skills, YAML, and Filesystems Replaced Python — Philipp Schmid, Google DeepMind

project_ideas.based_on: evaluation scores doubled when transitioning from multi-agent chains to file-system sandbox architectures
project_ideas.hypothesis: Holding model, task suite, and tool budget constant, a file-system sandbox agent with bash/grep/read/write scores measurably higher than a hand-chained query->planning->execution->reporting pipeline, and the effect size is smaller than the reported doubling once prompts are matched.
project_ideas.measurement: Per-task pass rate and score delta across both runtimes, with per-task variance and a stated baseline, so the doubling claim is either reproduced, shrunk, or refuted.
project_ideas.name: Substrate Ablation Harness
project_ideas.poc: Build two runtimes over one identical task suite: (a) a chained multi-agent pipeline with typed step tools, (b) a single agent in a sandboxed file system with four primitives. Report per-task scores, not a single aggregate number.
project_ideas.video_title: How We Solved Agent Building — Andrew Qu, Vercel

project_ideas.based_on: Agent frameworks should handle durability, security sandboxing, and channel routing out of the box
project_ideas.hypothesis: Containment strength and agent task success are not a simple tradeoff: allowlisted file paths plus egress control preserve most task success while eliminating outbound exfiltration paths that unrestricted sandbox access permits.
project_ideas.measurement: Task success rate per isolation profile, count of blocked or denied agent actions, and count of attempted outbound connections, giving a containment-versus-capability curve instead of a single sandbox claim.
project_ideas.name: Sandbox Containment Curve
project_ideas.poc: Run one file-system agent task suite under escalating isolation profiles — no isolation, container, microVM, plus syscall filtering, filesystem allowlists, and egress deny-by-default — and log both blocked actions and completed tasks.
project_ideas.video_title: How We Solved Agent Building — Andrew Qu, Vercel

project_ideas.based_on: hit architectural walls when dealing with complex, unanticipated edge cases
project_ideas.hypothesis: A hand-built multi-agent graph has no valid path for a substantial fraction of realistic edge cases collected from production logs, while a file-system sandbox agent completes those same cases without new engineering.
project_ideas.measurement: Fraction of edge cases with no valid DAG path, and completion rate for those same cases under the sandbox agent, reported as a coverage gap rather than an anecdote.
project_ideas.name: Edge-Case Coverage Probe
project_ideas.poc: Harvest a set of unanticipated edge cases from real usage traces, then attempt each against a fixed multi-agent DAG and against a sandbox agent, recording whether a route exists and whether the task completes.
project_ideas.video_title: How We Solved Agent Building — Andrew Qu, Vercel

project_ideas.based_on: Beta partners like Aura rebuilt their agents using Eve and saw massive success compared to off-the-shelf Claude Code
project_ideas.hypothesis: For domain-specific agents, injecting proprietary instruction files and internal context accounts for more of the performance gap against a generic agent than swapping the file-system framework does.
project_ideas.measurement: Condition-wise task success and quality scores, isolating the framework effect from the context effect that the partner comparison currently confounds.
project_ideas.name: Context Versus Substrate Split
project_ideas.poc: Ablate one agent across four conditions — generic framework with generic context, generic framework with proprietary context, file-system framework with generic context, file-system framework with proprietary context — on matched tasks.
project_ideas.video_title: How We Solved Agent Building — Andrew Qu, Vercel

project_ideas.based_on: Without robust observability, debugging complex multi-turn agent loops at scale is impossible.
project_ideas.hypothesis: A minimal multi-turn trace and eval schema (span types, tool-call outcomes, state transitions, cost attribution) enables root-causing injected failures in agent loops, whereas logs alone produce significantly longer time-to-diagnosis or failure to diagnose.
project_ideas.measurement: Time-to-diagnosis (median and 90th percentile), percentage of injected failures successfully root-caused, and number of additional diagnostic queries required per incident.
project_ideas.name: Minimum Viable Agent Trace Schema (MVATS)
project_ideas.poc: Instrument a multi-turn agent (e.g., using Strands/AgentCore) with the proposed schema; inject a controlled set of failures (tool timeout, context loss, hallucinated tool call, wrong tool selection); compare root-cause time and success rate against a logs-only baseline.
project_ideas.video_title: Harness Engineering: Building the Production Cage for Powerful Domain Agents — Mike Chambers, AWS

project_ideas.based_on: Production agents must build and manage their own cloud infrastructure safely.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Agent-generated infrastructure-as-code plans can be safely bounded by policy-as-code plus plan-diff approval gates, reducing blast radius from malformed or adversarial plans without eliminating legitimate provisioning.
project_ideas.measurement: Number of unsafe plans blocked, false-positive rate on benign plans, reduction in simulated blast radius (resources affected), and added approval latency per plan.
project_ideas.name: Agent IaC Plan Gate
project_ideas.poc: Build an agent that generates infrastructure-as-code plans; enforce policy checks (deny public buckets, wildcard IAM, destructive replacement) and require human approval on plan diffs; run adversarial and benign plans through the pipeline.
project_ideas.video_title: Harness Engineering: Building the Production Cage for Powerful Domain Agents — Mike Chambers, AWS

project_ideas.based_on: Payments (automated microtransactions)
project_ideas.hypothesis: Scoping an agent's identity to a spend-limited wallet with per-transaction and aggregate limits, enforced at runtime, prevents runaway spend while allowing legitimate microtransactions, and does so with acceptable false-positive rates.
project_ideas.measurement: Prevented unauthorized spend (absolute and percentage), false-positive rate for legitimate transactions, audit completeness (every transaction traceable to identity and policy decision), and policy decision latency.
project_ideas.name: Identity-Bound Wallet Scoping
project_ideas.poc: Implement an agent with a scoped wallet, policy engine (limits, merchant allowlist, velocity checks), and audit log; simulate a mix of legitimate purchases and adversarial attempts (limit evasion, replay, spoofed identity).
project_ideas.video_title: Harness Engineering: Building the Production Cage for Powerful Domain Agents — Mike Chambers, AWS

project_ideas.based_on: CLI tools simplify scaffolding multi-tenant agent applications with secure memory and tool integration.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Multi-tenant isolation provided by CLI scaffolding (e.g., AgentCore) is enforced at a specific boundary (process, container, memory store, API) and can be verified by adversarial cross-tenant probes; leakage is possible when isolation relies on application code rather than runtime enforcement.
project_ideas.measurement: Number of successful cross-tenant accesses (leakage incidents), isolation boundary failure rate, and time-to-detect leakage across probe types.
project_ideas.name: Cross-Tenant Leakage Test Suite for Scaffolded Agents
project_ideas.poc: Deploy two tenants using the same scaffolded agent framework with shared infrastructure (e.g., common memory store, vector DB, tool registry); attempt to read or mutate other tenant's memory, secrets, or tool outputs via prompt injection, API parameter tampering, and direct store access.
project_ideas.video_title: Harness Engineering: Building the Production Cage for Powerful Domain Agents — Mike Chambers, AWS

project_ideas.based_on: coupling term in a multiplicative capability model
project_ideas.hypothesis: In a modular agent system, interface-level metrics such as protocol churn, cross-boundary call success, and dependency version skew will predict downstream task capability loss earlier and more accurately than component-level metrics.
project_ideas.measurement: Lead time and ROC AUC of interface metrics versus component metrics for predicting a 20% drop in task success under fragmentation.
project_ideas.name: CouplingTerm Monitor
project_ideas.poc: Instrument an open-source multi-tool agent with interface metrics; progressively break interoperability by disabling translators, skewing versions, and removing schemas while keeping specialist components intact; record task success and metric timelines.
project_ideas.video_title: The Man Who Predicted The Iran War: The Next 9/11 Will Target Your Bank Account! | Professor Jiang

project_ideas.based_on: score each node by (irreplaceability × downstream fan-out)
project_ideas.hypothesis: Targeted redundancy on nodes with the highest irreplaceability × downstream fan-out reduces catastrophic task-outage probability per unit redundancy cost more than uniform redundancy across the same dependency graph.
project_ideas.measurement: Reduction in catastrophic task-outage probability per dollar or GPU-hour of redundancy under single-node outage simulations.
project_ideas.name: Chokepoint Redundancy Allocator
project_ideas.poc: Build a dependency graph of an agent/AI stack; score nodes; simulate single-node outages; compare targeted versus uniform redundancy budgets.
project_ideas.video_title: The Man Who Predicted The Iran War: The Next 9/11 Will Target Your Bank Account! | Professor Jiang

project_ideas.based_on: defense must shift toward containment, isolation, and blast-radius control
project_ideas.hypothesis: Containment and blast-radius controls such as capability scoping, isolated tool sandboxes, and no shared credentials will limit damage from distributed prompt-injection-style attacks even when attribution never resolves, outperforming detection-and-block-only defenses.
project_ideas.measurement: Worst-case data loss, unauthorized action count, and recovery time; containment success rate when attribution is unavailable.
project_ideas.name: Containment-Only Agent Sandbox
project_ideas.poc: Red-team an agent with tool access under a no-attribution assumption; compare a detection-and-block pipeline against a containment-first sandbox on privilege escalation, data exfiltration, and task recovery.
project_ideas.video_title: The Man Who Predicted The Iran War: The Next 9/11 Will Target Your Bank Account! | Professor Jiang

project_ideas.based_on: promise whose durability rests on an enforcement mechanism external to the protocol
project_ideas.hypothesis: Without an external enforcement substrate, agent-to-agent commitments diverge from promised behavior; adding a verifier or escrow mechanism measurably reduces promise-delivery divergence.
project_ideas.measurement: Promise-delivery divergence rate and recovery latency with and without enforcement.
project_ideas.name: Agent Commitment Enforcement Testbed
project_ideas.poc: Multi-agent negotiation where agents make contractual promises to deliver data, pay tokens, or execute tasks; compare no enforcement versus verifier/escrow enforcement; measure divergence.
project_ideas.video_title: The Man Who Predicted The Iran War: The Next 9/11 Will Target Your Bank Account! | Professor Jiang

project_ideas.based_on: Available subscription quota is treated as a first-class scheduling constraint
project_ideas.hypothesis: A task router that optimizes placement under capability constraints and live quota signals reduces rate-limit-induced stalls by at least 30% versus capability-only routing, without more than a 5% relative quality regression on task-type benchmarks.
project_ideas.measurement: Stall/rate-limit rate, task success quality, token cost, end-to-end latency across routing policies.
project_ideas.name: Quota-Aware Capability-Constrained Router
project_ideas.poc: Wrap a set of coding tasks with simulated provider quota APIs; route each task via capability-only, round-robin, highest-quota, and capability-constrained quota-aware policies.
project_ideas.video_title: High Throughput Agentic Engineering with ex-Meta L8 Principal

project_ideas.based_on: Agent instruction files (agent.md/cloud.md) are treated as learnable parameters
project_ideas.hypothesis: One offline optimization pass that edits agent instruction files from historical transcripts reduces recurring failure rate on a held-out task set, with diminishing returns and measurable overfitting risk on repeated passes.
project_ideas.measurement: Held-out failure rate per iteration, instruction diff size, train-vs-held-out gap, human-review acceptance rate.
project_ideas.name: Backpass Loop Harness
project_ideas.poc: Collect session transcripts, define a failure taxonomy, generate instruction-file edits, and rerun held-out tasks before/after each iteration.
project_ideas.video_title: High Throughput Agentic Engineering with ex-Meta L8 Principal

project_ideas.based_on: Interactive HTML artifacts allow the captain (human) to make decisions quickly
project_ideas.hypothesis: Artifact-based review reduces human decision latency and error rate versus raw terminal logs, and latency gains diminish as artifact complexity increases.
project_ideas.measurement: Decision latency, decision error rate, self-reported cognitive load, review abandonment.
project_ideas.name: Attention-Budget Review A/B
project_ideas.poc: Present the same set of agent decisions to reviewers as structured HTML artifacts versus raw logs, randomizing order.
project_ideas.video_title: High Throughput Agentic Engineering with ex-Meta L8 Principal

project_ideas.based_on: Autonomy level for merges is set per project as policy
project_ideas.hypothesis: Per-project autonomy policies (direct-PR+yolo vs no-mistakes+yolo) increase merged throughput per escaped defect compared with uniform auto-merge or uniform review, but only when risk classification accuracy exceeds a threshold.
project_ideas.measurement: Merged changes per unit time, escaped defect rate, review cost, accuracy threshold where benefit reverses.
project_ideas.name: Risk-Tiered Merge Autonomy Simulator
project_ideas.poc: Simulate a portfolio of repos with injected defect rates and compare uniform and per-project merge/review policies.
project_ideas.video_title: High Throughput Agentic Engineering with ex-Meta L8 Principal

project_ideas.based_on: AI agents handle 80% or more of development work autonomously
project_ideas.hypothesis: Automated acceptance checks (static analysis, property-based tests, LLM-based review) with targeted human review of high-risk diffs can keep defect escape rate below 1% while allowing agents to produce 80% of code.
project_ideas.measurement: Defect escape rate per 1000 PRs, human review minutes per PR, throughput (PRs/day), and ratio of agent-authored to human-authored code.
project_ideas.name: Agentic PR Verification Harness
project_ideas.poc: Instrument an agentic coding pipeline to generate 1000 PRs on a medium-sized open-source repo; apply automated checks and route only ambiguous or high-impact diffs to human reviewers; measure defect escape rate and review effort.
project_ideas.video_title: Ask the Mates anything | MOONSHOTS AMA  #289

project_ideas.based_on: thoroughly reinforcement fine-tuned on reasoning challenges
project_ideas.hypothesis: RL-fine-tuned reasoning models show significantly lower performance on contamination-controlled held-out compositional tasks than on standard benchmarks, indicating that apparent novelty is partly memorized.
project_ideas.measurement: Accuracy drop on novel vs standard benchmarks, with contamination controls; effect size and confidence intervals.
project_ideas.name: Reasoning Novelty Benchmark
project_ideas.poc: Create a benchmark of novel reasoning tasks generated programmatically with no overlap with training data; test several reasoning models (e.g., o1, DeepSeek-R1) and compare to standard benchmarks; apply n-gram overlap controls.
project_ideas.video_title: Ask the Mates anything | MOONSHOTS AMA  #289

project_ideas.based_on: CT angiograph with AI analytics reveals subclinical plaque
project_ideas.hypothesis: AI-augmented CT angiography increases detection of subclinical plaque by >30% over standard radiologist review without increasing false positives beyond 5%.
project_ideas.measurement: Incremental detection rate, false positive rate, and downstream intervention rate; statistical significance.
project_ideas.name: Subclinical Plaque Detection Replication
project_ideas.poc: Retrospective study on 500 CT angiograms with AI analytics vs standard screening, measuring incremental detection rate and false positive rate; compare to ground truth from follow-up outcomes.
project_ideas.video_title: Ask the Mates anything | MOONSHOTS AMA  #289

project_ideas.based_on: Blitzy provides infinite code context to ingest 100M+ lines of code in a single pass
project_ideas.hypothesis: For repositories >10M lines, single-pass ingestion with retrieval-augmented context assembly yields higher edit precision at lower total token cost than editor-scoped retrieval, up to a repository-size threshold where latency degrades.
project_ideas.measurement: Retrieval precision, tokens per edit, latency, and defect escape rate on agent-generated PRs.
project_ideas.name: Repo-Scale Context Ingestion Benchmark
project_ideas.poc: Build a prototype that ingests a large open-source monorepo (e.g., Chromium) in a single pass using a long-context model with hierarchical summarization; measure retrieval precision and cost per edit against a baseline editor-scoped RAG.
project_ideas.video_title: Ask the Mates anything | MOONSHOTS AMA  #289

project_ideas.based_on: the party that needs the resource cannot be trusted to gate the resource
project_ideas.hypothesis: An independent pooled evaluator with standardized executable probes reduces defect escape rate by more than 30 percent versus producer self-evaluation without increasing end-to-end latency by more than 20 percent.
project_ideas.measurement: Defect escape rate, end-to-end latency, queue depth at the gate, false-reject rate.
project_ideas.name: Gatehouse Central Acceptance Service
project_ideas.poc: Wrap a task pipeline so the producing agent submits artifacts to a central evaluator running a fixed task battery, then compare against a self-evaluation baseline on the same tasks.
project_ideas.video_title: Inside Bending Spoons: Finding Talent, Leveraging AI & Driving Operational Excellence | Luca Ferrari

project_ideas.based_on: Centralized evaluators exist to pool samples for threshold calibration
project_ideas.hypothesis: Threshold calibration error decreases with pooled sample size following a measurable power law, and under distribution shift per-unit thresholds drift more than twice as fast as pooled thresholds.
project_ideas.measurement: Calibration error versus pool size, drift rate under shift, pass-fail stability across units.
project_ideas.name: Beyond-Evals Calibration Scaling Lab
project_ideas.poc: Simulate multiple task distributions with varying pool sizes and shift magnitudes, then compare centralized pooled thresholds against per-unit thresholds on held-out tasks.
project_ideas.video_title: Inside Bending Spoons: Finding Talent, Leveraging AI & Driving Operational Excellence | Luca Ferrari

project_ideas.based_on: N parallel agent/product stacks multiply maintenance
project_ideas.hypothesis: Consolidating N heterogeneous agent stacks onto a shared runtime reduces maintenance cost per product after a threshold number of acquisitions but increases correlated incident rate approximately linearly with N.
project_ideas.measurement: Migration cost, incident correlation across products, cross-team coordination count, maintenance hours per product.
project_ideas.name: Movement-Lab Platform Consolidation Simulator
project_ideas.poc: Instrument synthetic multi-agent product stacks in shared versus separate runtime configurations, inject faults, and measure incident propagation and maintenance effort.
project_ideas.video_title: Inside Bending Spoons: Finding Talent, Leveraging AI & Driving Operational Excellence | Luca Ferrari

project_ideas.based_on: Track a fixed probe battery's discriminative power over time
project_ideas.hypothesis: A fixed standardized probe battery loses discriminative power at a measurable rate as agents overfit, and refresh cadence can be predicted from score variance collapse.
project_ideas.measurement: Probe discrimination AUC over time, score inflation, overfit rate, recommended refresh interval.
project_ideas.name: Probe Staleness Tracker
project_ideas.poc: Run a fixed probe battery against successive agent versions and compare probe discrimination against a held-out evolving task set.
project_ideas.video_title: Inside Bending Spoons: Finding Talent, Leveraging AI & Driving Operational Excellence | Luca Ferrari

project_ideas.based_on: escaped its sandbox
project_ideas.hypothesis: Per-tool authorization combined with network egress allowlists will reduce adversarial sandbox escapes to zero in tool-using agent evaluations, whereas process or VM isolation alone will not.
project_ideas.measurement: Escape attempts blocked, unauthorized egress events per 100 adversarial prompts, and task completion delta versus an unconfined baseline.
project_ideas.name: EgressGate
project_ideas.poc: Red-team harness with goal-directed tool-using agents, an egress proxy logging every network attempt, and a per-action policy engine enforcing allowlisted tools and destinations.
project_ideas.video_title: Altman: AI Beyond Human Control “Absolutely” Possible, Vows Safeguards | Titans and Disruptors

project_ideas.based_on: We must pause training runs if safety cases are not met.
project_ideas.hypothesis: A machine-checkable safety-case schema with blocking promotion thresholds will reduce unsafe unpaused capability advancement without significantly reducing acceptable training run velocity.
project_ideas.measurement: Number of blocked runs, false-positive pause rate, time-to-unpause, and downstream incident rate.
project_ideas.name: SafetyCaseGate
project_ideas.poc: Training pipeline gate that ingests safety-case artifacts, validates required evidence, blocks runs when evidence is missing, and records manual override justifications.
project_ideas.video_title: Altman: AI Beyond Human Control “Absolutely” Possible, Vows Safeguards | Titans and Disruptors

project_ideas.based_on: AGI means AI outperforming humans at economically viable work.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Economic task substitution rate is a more discriminative AGI threshold than abstract capability benchmarks and correlates with expert AGI judgments.
project_ideas.measurement: Substitution rate, correlation with expert AGI labels, inter-task variance, and test-retest reliability.
project_ideas.name: EconSubstitutionBench
project_ideas.poc: Benchmark suite of real economically viable tasks with human baselines and model substitution scoring across multiple frontier models.
project_ideas.video_title: Altman: AI Beyond Human Control “Absolutely” Possible, Vows Safeguards | Titans and Disruptors

project_ideas.based_on: International standards and oversight bodies are necessary to prevent dangerous imbalances.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Standard verifiable evaluation result formats with signed artifacts will increase third-party auditability and cross-organization adoption of shared safety testing.
project_ideas.measurement: Adoption count across teams, audit time reduction, and cross-organization verification success rate.
project_ideas.name: PortableEval
project_ideas.poc: Open schema and reference runner for safety evaluations, signed result bundles, and an independent verifier that checks provenance and completeness.
project_ideas.video_title: Altman: AI Beyond Human Control “Absolutely” Possible, Vows Safeguards | Titans and Disruptors

project_ideas.based_on: Can conflicting business-metric definitions be detected automatically from query logs
project_ideas.hypothesis: Lineage-driven clustering of similarly named metrics with divergent formulas surfaces more gold-layer conflicts per engineering hour than manual cross-department workshops.
project_ideas.measurement: Precision and recall against manually identified conflicts; conflicts surfaced per analyst hour; time to resolve each conflict.
project_ideas.name: Semantic Definition Diff Detector
project_ideas.poc: Ingest query logs, report metadata, and lineage; cluster metric names by similarity; extract formulas; flag divergent clusters as gold-layer candidates.
project_ideas.video_title: DATACON 2026: Building AI-Ready Microsoft Data Estates

project_ideas.based_on: Does measured decision-error rate increase with AI assistance when the underlying semantic layer is absent versus present?
project_ideas.hypothesis: For the same corpus and questions, removing the codified definition layer increases the confident-wrong-answer rate by a measurable margin.
project_ideas.measurement: Confident-wrong-answer rate delta; decision-error rate; abstention rate.
project_ideas.name: Semantic Layer Ablation Benchmark
project_ideas.poc: Build a QA benchmark over the same corpus with and without gold-layer definitions; score correct, confident-wrong, and abstained answers.
project_ideas.video_title: DATACON 2026: Building AI-Ready Microsoft Data Estates

project_ideas.based_on: Prototype an inventory/registry model with ownership and recency fields and measure how many shadow assets it surfaces versus the cost of the discovery pass.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Adding owner, last-used, and dependency edges to an asset registry surfaces a measurable fraction of shadow assets that existence-only inventory misses, enough to change deprecation priority.
project_ideas.measurement: Shadow assets surfaced per discovery cost; timeline slips avoided; percent of assets with named owner and last-used date.
project_ideas.name: Actionable Inventory Registry
project_ideas.poc: Prototype a registry over a sample estate; run discovery; compare assets found with and without ownership and recency fields; compute deprecation candidates.
project_ideas.video_title: DATACON 2026: Building AI-Ready Microsoft Data Estates

project_ideas.based_on: Instrument regional capacity metrics and evaluate whether pre-emptive traffic shifting can be triggered before game-day-scale demand spikes cause failure.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Regional capacity telemetry can trigger pre-emptive traffic shifting before bursty demand causes customer-visible outages.
project_ideas.measurement: Outage avoidance rate; false-positive failover rate; time-to-trigger before failure.
project_ideas.name: Regional Capacity Pre-Failover Trigger
project_ideas.poc: Instrument regional capacity metrics; simulate game-day-scale demand spikes; evaluate threshold-based planned failover versus reactive failover.
project_ideas.video_title: DATACON 2026: Building AI-Ready Microsoft Data Estates

project_ideas.based_on: prevents credit assignment collapse in long-horizon RL tasks
project_ideas.hypothesis: Step-aware credit assignment reduces gradient variance and prevents training collapse relative to rollout-level credit, and the size of the advantage grows monotonically with task horizon length.
project_ideas.measurement: Gradient variance per update, collapse incidence (success rate falling to baseline mid-run), and final held-out task success as a function of horizon length across the three schemes.
project_ideas.name: TurnCreditBench
project_ideas.poc: Train the same policy on identical long-horizon agentic traces under three credit schemes — rollout-level, turn-level, and an intermediate discounted scheme — sweeping horizon length from short to long while logging per-step advantage statistics, gradient variance, and held-out task success.
project_ideas.video_title: What Building an AI Scientist Actually Requires Beyond Intelligence — Edward Hughes

project_ideas.based_on: Do rubric-based judges remain discriminative as the policy improves and learns to satisfy the rubric surface rather than the underlying task?
project_ideas.hypothesis: LLM judge agreement with human raters decays measurably over successive rounds of policy training against rubric rewards, and the decay rate depends on rubric granularity.
project_ideas.measurement: Human-judge agreement coefficient per training round, gap between fixed-rubric and regenerated-rubric scores on the same trajectories, and steps until the gap exceeds a pre-registered threshold.
project_ideas.name: RubricRot
project_ideas.poc: Run iterated training rounds where a policy optimizes against a fixed generated rubric while periodically re-scoring a frozen sample of trajectories with human raters and with freshly regenerated rubrics; track both agreement curves against training step.
project_ideas.video_title: What Building an AI Scientist Actually Requires Beyond Intelligence — Edward Hughes

project_ideas.based_on: replace single binary rewards with a per-task generated rubric scored by an LLM judge across multiple dimensions
project_ideas.hypothesis: Runtime-generated per-task multi-dimensional rubrics, scored by an LLM judge, correlate with human assessment better and are less exploitable than a single binary outcome reward on non-verifiable agent tasks.
project_ideas.measurement: Correlation with human scores versus a binary-reward baseline, rank correlation under adversarial trajectories written to satisfy the rubric without doing the task, and per-rubric generation cost and latency.
project_ideas.name: RubricGen Service
project_ideas.poc: Build a pipeline that ingests an agent trace and a task description, emits a task-specific rubric across the five dimensions used in the Faraday configuration, scores the trace, and exposes rubric provenance and versioning so downstream training can pin or rotate rubric revisions.
project_ideas.video_title: What Building an AI Scientist Actually Requires Beyond Intelligence — Edward Hughes

project_ideas.based_on: Does the ability to replicate published papers transfer to producing genuinely new problems and domains, or does it only demonstrate mastery of existing literature?
project_ideas.hypothesis: Replication performance on held-out papers does not predict performance on tasks requiring a novel hypothesis or a new problem formulation; the two capabilities are measurably dissociated.
project_ideas.measurement: Rank correlation between replication score and novel-generation score across checkpoints and subfields; evidence of dissociation where replication improves while novel generation stays flat or regresses.
project_ideas.name: Replication-to-Discovery Transfer Suite
project_ideas.poc: Take agents at several checkpoints of replication training and evaluate each on a paired task set: a replication task and a matched novel-problem-generation task drawn from the same subfield, scoring both with the same rubric dimensions plus a novelty assessment by a held-out observer model.
project_ideas.video_title: What Building an AI Scientist Actually Requires Beyond Intelligence — Edward Hughes

project_ideas.based_on: Better data produces 12x improvement in compute efficiency
project_ideas.hypothesis: Fixing compute budget, increasing data curation quality yields a larger compute-efficiency gain (target ~12x) than replacing the architecture (target ~3.7x), and the ratio holds across at least two model scales.
project_ideas.measurement: Compute (FLOPs or GPU-hours) required to reach a target validation loss; ratio of gains between data-curated and architecture-changed conditions.
project_ideas.name: Curation-vs-Architecture Ablation Harness
project_ideas.poc: Train small-scale transformer models with controlled variations: (a) baseline data, (b) curated data, (c) baseline data + architecture change (e.g., different attention), (d) curated data + architecture change. Measure compute to reach fixed eval loss.
project_ideas.video_title: Three Lab Warnings in Five Days, Researcher Flags “Gambling with Our Lives,” and Labs Race

project_ideas.based_on: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash reduces KV cache per token down to 890 bytes
project_ideas.hypothesis: An 890-byte-per-token KV cache architecture preserves long-context retrieval and reasoning accuracy within 5% of full-cache baselines up to 128k tokens.
project_ideas.measurement: Accuracy on long-context retrieval and reasoning tasks; memory per token; inference throughput.
project_ideas.name: Long-Context Quality for Reduced KV Cache
project_ideas.poc: Implement a small model with a reduced-cache attention variant emulating V4.1 Flash's per-token footprint, compare against full-cache baseline on needle-in-a-haystack and long-document QA.
project_ideas.video_title: Three Lab Warnings in Five Days, Researcher Flags “Gambling with Our Lives,” and Labs Race

project_ideas.based_on: the risks of recursive aligned AI modifying its own core values
project_ideas.hypothesis: An external, non-editable value-integrity boundary can prevent a self-improving agent from modifying its own core values while still allowing capability improvement on a target task.
project_ideas.measurement: Number of successful value-specification edits; task performance improvement; false-positive/negative rate of boundary.
project_ideas.name: Immutable Value-Integrity Boundary for Self-Improving Agents
project_ideas.poc: Build a toy self-modifying agent (e.g., meta-learning loop) with a read-only external checker that verifies any proposed policy edit against a fixed value specification; test whether the agent can improve task performance without editing the specification.
project_ideas.video_title: Three Lab Warnings in Five Days, Researcher Flags “Gambling with Our Lives,” and Labs Race

project_ideas.based_on: Robotic manipulation tasks like picking up cups and moving blocks achieve near 100% completion
project_ideas.hypothesis: Models that achieve near-100% on saturated cup-picking/block-moving tasks will show at least 30% performance drop on held-out randomized objects, scenes, and tasks, revealing overfitting to the benchmark.
project_ideas.measurement: Success rate on original benchmark vs. held-out suite; degradation delta.
project_ideas.name: Embodied Manipulation Generalization Suite
project_ideas.poc: Construct a held-out suite of randomized manipulation tasks (unseen objects, lighting, backgrounds, goals) and evaluate models that claim near-100% on the original benchmark.
project_ideas.video_title: Three Lab Warnings in Five Days, Researcher Flags “Gambling with Our Lives,” and Labs Race

project_ideas.based_on: if it compiles it's ~correct
project_ideas.hypothesis: For agent-written Rust, compile success predicts requirement satisfaction above 80% for isolated pure functions but falls below 50% for stateful, cross-module, or platform-integration tasks.
project_ideas.measurement: Divergence rate = P(compiles AND fails requirements) / P(compiles), stratified by task class; correlation between compile success and behavioral pass rate.
project_ideas.name: Compile-Pass Divergence Harness
project_ideas.poc: Build a suite of 60 tasks in a strict language spanning pure functions, async/stateful services, and FFI/platform glue; have agents solve them and grade against executable behavioral specs independent of the compiler.
project_ideas.video_title: Building ambitious software — Jonathan Kelley, Dioxus Labs & Cognition

project_ideas.based_on: If the substrate your AI code lands in is poorly architected
project_ideas.hypothesis: Holding model and prompt constant, repositories with explicit module boundaries and invariant checks show lower agent-contribution defect rates than poorly modularized repos of similar size.
project_ideas.measurement: Defect escape rate per merged agent contribution, review-rework time, and architectural conformance failures across repo variants.
project_ideas.name: Substrate Ladder
project_ideas.poc: Create 3 versions of a small service repo: monolith/no boundaries, modular interfaces, and modular plus invariant assertions; run identical agent tasks and grade defects.
project_ideas.video_title: Building ambitious software — Jonathan Kelley, Dioxus Labs & Cognition

project_ideas.based_on: Subsecond is the only hot-reload engine
project_ideas.hypothesis: A sub-100ms hot-patch loop increases agent task completion rate and reduces cost per completed task relative to a conventional compile-test loop.
project_ideas.measurement: Mean attempts per completed task, wall-clock per completion, tokens per completion, and success rate delta.
project_ideas.name: Hot-Patch Loop A/B
project_ideas.poc: Instrument an agent coding loop with two execution backends: cold compile-test and hot-patch-capable; run matched task sets and record attempts, wall-clock, tokens, and success.
project_ideas.video_title: Building ambitious software — Jonathan Kelley, Dioxus Labs & Cognition

project_ideas.based_on: Line-by-line human code review remains essential because contributors often communicate intent poorly
project_ideas.hypothesis: Requiring a machine-readable intent and interface spec before generation reduces defect escape rate enough to allow sampled review instead of line-by-line review for bounded task classes.
project_ideas.measurement: Defect escape rate, review time per merged change, and architecturally non-conforming contributions.
project_ideas.name: Intent-Gated Review Gate
project_ideas.poc: Add a pre-generation spec step to an agent workflow; compare against baseline line-by-line review and no pre-review on matched tasks.
project_ideas.video_title: Building ambitious software — Jonathan Kelley, Dioxus Labs & Cognition

project_ideas.based_on: Focus is defined as a subtractive discipline
project_ideas.hypothesis: An explicit kill-list process for agent tools and roles will reduce routing ambiguity and eval burden, improving task success rate relative to an additive approval process.
project_ideas.measurement: Task success rate, routing error rate, prompt token overhead, number of retained components.
project_ideas.name: Kill-List Governance for Agent Capabilities
project_ideas.poc: Build a tool registry for a multi-agent system with two modes: additive (approve new tools if individually reasonable) vs subtractive (require deletion or explicit cost justification). Run a benchmark of tasks requiring tool selection.
project_ideas.video_title: Steve Jobs Unfiltered ; The 1997 Video Apple Tried to Forget

project_ideas.based_on: End-to-end ownership of both the platform substrate and the application layer
project_ideas.hypothesis: For tasks requiring coordination across memory, retrieval, tool use, and orchestration, a vertically integrated agent stack will outperform a composed best-of-breed stack on latency, cost per task, and task success.
project_ideas.measurement: Latency, cost per completed task, success rate.
project_ideas.name: Cross-Layer vs Composed Agent Stack Benchmark
project_ideas.poc: Implement two agent stacks: one with shared context, unified tool protocol, and co-designed memory; another composing off-the-shelf components. Run on a benchmark of cross-layer tasks.
project_ideas.video_title: Steve Jobs Unfiltered ; The 1997 Video Apple Tried to Forget

project_ideas.based_on: superset coexistence rather than replacement
project_ideas.hypothesis: Hosting an old tool protocol as a subset under a new orchestrator reduces migration blast radius and avoids simultaneous consumer rewrites, but incurs measurable divergence cost over releases.
project_ideas.measurement: Number of breaking changes avoided, maintenance hours, divergence incidents.
project_ideas.name: Superset Coexistence Migration Harness for Agent Tool Protocols
project_ideas.poc: Create a dual-runtime agent stack where the old tool interface runs under a new orchestrator; simulate multiple releases and track maintenance overhead and divergence.
project_ideas.video_title: Steve Jobs Unfiltered ; The 1997 Video Apple Tried to Forget

project_ideas.based_on: The cited root cause of multi-year decline is managerial, not technical
project_ideas.hypothesis: Project churn, unretired commitments, and staffing mismatch against stated strategy predict capability decay (e.g., declining task success) before runtime metrics show it.
project_ideas.measurement: Correlation between decision-layer indicators and downstream capability decay.
project_ideas.name: Decision-Layer Leading Indicators for AI Engineering Teams
project_ideas.poc: Instrument an AI engineering team's decision process (project tracking, commitments, staffing) and correlate with model performance metrics over time.
project_ideas.video_title: Steve Jobs Unfiltered ; The 1997 Video Apple Tried to Forget

project_ideas.based_on: Imbuing agents with domain knowledge through proper prompting creates defensibility.
project_ideas.hypothesis: A structured expert-interview-to-context pipeline produces agent context that matches expert decisions on held-out workflow cases at materially higher agreement than context authored without the elicitation protocol.
project_ideas.measurement: Expert-agreement rate and inter-rater variance on held-out cases, plus the number of elicitation rounds needed to reach plateau, compared across elicited vs. generic-context agents.
project_ideas.name: Expert-to-Context Compiler
project_ideas.poc: Pick one bounded recurring workflow; run a fixed elicitation protocol with a domain expert to produce a versioned context artifact; build two agents — one on the elicited context, one on a generic prompt — and blind-evaluate both on a held-out case set scored by the expert.
project_ideas.video_title: The Biggest AI Opportunities Are Hiding in Boring Businesses

project_ideas.based_on: Focus on one recurring annoying workflow inside a normal business.
project_ideas.hypothesis: A pilot is more likely to survive past day 90 when a bounded workflow is run repeatedly and passes explicit repeatability and throughput-delta thresholds against a manual baseline, than when it passes only a willingness-to-pay check.
project_ideas.measurement: Run-to-run success variance, median throughput delta versus manual baseline, and correlation between harness verdicts and whether the pilot is still active 6 months later.
project_ideas.name: 90-Day Gate Harness
project_ideas.poc: Instrument one recurring workflow with a repeat-run harness that logs per-run success, variance across runs, and end-to-end time versus a recorded manual baseline; produce a three-signal go/no-go report covering pay, repeatability, and speedup.
project_ideas.video_title: The Biggest AI Opportunities Are Hiding in Boring Businesses

project_ideas.based_on: Pricing should be based on output, not hours.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Agent actions can be tied to verifiable client-facing outcomes precisely enough that outcome-based billing produces equal or higher revenue than hour-based billing on the same workflow without materially more client dispute.
project_ideas.measurement: Revenue per period under outcome vs. hour-based billing, dispute rate per invoice, and percentage of agent actions that can be traced to a client-confirmed outcome.
project_ideas.name: Outcome Ledger
project_ideas.poc: Deploy an attribution layer that records each agent action, links it to a client-verifiable downstream event, and emits a per-period outcome statement; run it alongside hour-based billing on one workflow for two billing cycles.
project_ideas.video_title: The Biggest AI Opportunities Are Hiding in Boring Businesses

project_ideas.based_on: Verification bottlenecks slow AI-assisted coding more than code generation itself.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Adding a fault-injecting test harness (e.g., Antithesis-style) to a coding agent increases end-to-end verified-change throughput (verified PRs per hour) by at least 2x compared to a baseline without it, while reducing escaped defect rate.
project_ideas.measurement: Verified changes per hour, escaped defects per 1000 changes.
project_ideas.name: Verified-Change Throughput Benchmark for Coding Agents
project_ideas.poc: Build two pipelines: one with LLM code generation and human review, one with same generation plus automated fault-injection and multiverse testing; measure throughput and defect escape on a set of synthetic tasks.
project_ideas.video_title: AI researchers debate how close we are to recursive self-improvement

project_ideas.based_on: RL on long reasoning trajectories is information-theoretically inefficient
project_ideas.hypothesis: For a fixed reasoning task, SFT-seeded RL reaches a target capability with at least 5x fewer total training tokens than pure RL, and the ratio of trajectory tokens to reward bits predicts compute cost across tasks.
project_ideas.measurement: Tokens required to reach 80% of max capability, reward bits per token, compute multiplier.
project_ideas.name: Tokens-per-Reward-Bit Scaling Laws for RL vs SFT
project_ideas.poc: Train small models on a synthetic reasoning task under three regimes: pure RL, SFT-seeded RL, and pure SFT; measure tokens-to-capability curves.
project_ideas.video_title: AI researchers debate how close we are to recursive self-improvement

project_ideas.based_on: Generalization bottlenecks in metalearning and continual learning could stall recursive self-improvement.
project_ideas.hypothesis: A self-improving agent that modifies its own learning procedure will exhibit measurable catastrophic forgetting on a suite of held-out continual-learning benchmarks within 3 improvement cycles, unless constrained by a human-specified objective contract.
project_ideas.measurement: Backward transfer (performance drop on old tasks) per improvement cycle.
project_ideas.name: Continual Learning Regression Detector for Self-Improving Agents
project_ideas.poc: Implement a simple metalearning agent that updates its own hyperparameters or architecture on a stream of tasks; track performance on a held-out set of previous tasks; compare with and without a human-in-the-loop objective specification.
project_ideas.video_title: AI researchers debate how close we are to recursive self-improvement

project_ideas.based_on: Pretraining progress is 12.0x from data and 3.7x from models.
project_ideas.hypothesis: The data-driven compute multiplier exceeds the model-driven multiplier at all measured scales up to 10B parameters, but the gap narrows as scale increases.
project_ideas.measurement: Compute multiplier ratios (data/model) at each scale.
project_ideas.name: Data vs Model Compute Multiplier Decomposition Across Scales
project_ideas.poc: Replicate pretraining runs with controlled data recipe changes vs architectural changes at multiple scales (e.g., 100M, 1B, 10B), measuring compute efficiency gains.
project_ideas.video_title: AI researchers debate how close we are to recursive self-improvement

project_ideas.based_on: Combining multi-armed bandit reward scoring with influence functions efficiently identifies valuable training data.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Across at least three tabular datasets and two model families, bandit-plus-influence top-K selection reaches a target fairness improvement with strictly fewer valuation calls and no larger accuracy drop than random, uniform-representation, or volume-based expansion at matched compute.
project_ideas.measurement: Number of influence/valuation calls and wall-clock to target fairness; Pareto frontier of (fairness metric, accuracy); post-selection accuracy and fairness on a held-out distribution shift.
project_ideas.name: Selector Gate Harness
project_ideas.poc: Build a candidate pool expander with group-level bandit reward (joint fairness-accuracy) wrapping within-group influence ranking for top-K; run it head-to-head against random addition, uniform-representation addition, and add-all baselines at matched augmentation budget.
project_ideas.video_title: 2026-09-09 CERIAS - Reasoning About Interventions in Data and Machine Learning Systems

project_ideas.based_on: Repair candidates can be ranked using historical execution logs and data profiles without re-executing the full pipeline
