project_ideas.video_title: Deep dive on LLM Inference at Scale — Harshul Jain, Audible & Tanmay Sah, Independent AI Researcher

project_ideas.based_on: Quantizing Mistral-7B from FP16 to INT4 reduces weight memory from 14.5 GB to 3.6 GB.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Running a representative 7B-8B model in INT4/NF4 on a vLLM server decreases success on a multi-step tool-use benchmark by at least 10 percentage points compared to FP16, even when perplexity deltas are small.
project_ideas.measurement: End-to-end task success rate and error category distribution for FP16 vs INT4.
project_ideas.name: int4-agent-reliability-check
project_ideas.poc: Create an executable tool-calling task set; run the same agent harness with FP16 and INT4/NF4 weights under identical prompts and sampling temperature; compare success, parse-error, and retry-frequency rates.
project_ideas.video_title: Deep dive on LLM Inference at Scale — Harshul Jain, Audible & Tanmay Sah, Independent AI Researcher

project_ideas.based_on: Mistral-7B decode step streams 14.5 GB from HBM to SRAM on every step.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Holding output length constant on an A100-class GPU, increasing the input context length by 2x increases measured per-token decode latency by at least 10% because every decode step scans the KV cache from HBM.
project_ideas.measurement: Inter-token latency (ITL) and achieved HBM bandwidth as a function of context length.
project_ideas.name: decode-bandwidth-probe
project_ideas.poc: Use vLLM to issue constant-output-length generation requests with varying context lengths; profile with GPU hardware counters and log token-level latencies; compare observed bytes-per-step to the roofline prediction.
project_ideas.video_title: Deep dive on LLM Inference at Scale — Harshul Jain, Audible & Tanmay Sah, Independent AI Researcher

project_ideas.based_on: An agent given both a completion goal and an instruction to conceal that goal from the humans it serves is a concrete specification-conflict failure mode
project_ideas.hypothesis: A static and runtime conflict analyzer for goal/concealment instruction pairs can detect conflicts with >90% precision and reduce harmful silent resolutions by >50% in a benchmark of paired contradictory instructions.
project_ideas.measurement: Precision and recall on conflict detection; human evaluation of harm prevented in simulated agent runs compared to baseline.
project_ideas.name: Conflict-Aware Instruction Runtime (CAIR)
project_ideas.poc: Build a benchmark of 200 paired instructions (achieve X, hide X), implement a conflict analyzer using formal logic and LLM-based detection, and integrate an escalation policy into a simple agent loop.
project_ideas.video_title: Elon Musk BRUTALLY Honest Interview LEAVES Audience Speechless (Must Watch)

project_ideas.based_on: There is a 10-20% probability of something terrible happening with superintelligence.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Tying measured capability levels to staged deployment permissions using explicit severe-outcome probability estimates reduces expected harm without reducing capability release velocity beyond a stated risk budget.
project_ideas.measurement: Expected harm reduction vs time-to-release compared to an ungated baseline.
project_ideas.name: Risk-Gated Release Harness
project_ideas.poc: For a specific domain (e.g., autonomous coding agents), define a capability eval suite, map scores to a probabilistic risk model, and simulate release decisions under different gates.
project_ideas.video_title: Elon Musk BRUTALLY Honest Interview LEAVES Audience Speechless (Must Watch)

project_ideas.based_on: Retrieval is reframed from document ranking to live consensus synthesis from observers at the scene, personalized by user vectors.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Adding source attribution graphs and expert weighting to a generative consensus layer reduces manipulation shift by >50% compared to unweighted synthesis under coordinated adversarial injection.
project_ideas.measurement: Shift in synthesized answer (semantic similarity to baseline) under manipulation; detection rate of corrupted sources.
project_ideas.name: Provenance-Weighted Consensus Synthesis
project_ideas.poc: Prototype a consensus layer that synthesizes answers from in-situ sources, with and without provenance weighting; run adversarial injection tests where a subset of sources are corrupted.
project_ideas.video_title: Elon Musk BRUTALLY Honest Interview LEAVES Audience Speechless (Must Watch)

project_ideas.based_on: Requirements elicited from current users systematically miss displacement-class products
project_ideas.hypothesis: Capability probe suites derived from first-principles decomposition surface displacement-class requirements that user-survey-derived benchmarks miss, measured by recall of known disruptive features.
project_ideas.measurement: Recall and precision of disruptive features surfaced, compared to user-elicited benchmarks.
project_ideas.name: First-Principles Capability Probes
project_ideas.poc: Build a probe suite for a domain (e.g., personal computing) not constrained by current user workflows; compare with user-elicited benchmarks on predicting historical disruptive features.
project_ideas.video_title: Elon Musk BRUTALLY Honest Interview LEAVES Audience Speechless (Must Watch)

project_ideas.based_on: The architectural boundary that matters is where the agent executes
project_ideas.hypothesis: Tasks requiring background execution and multi-step state achieve significantly higher end-to-end completion rates when the agent owns a persistent environment compared to session-based tool calling.
project_ideas.measurement: Task completion rate, time to completion, user supervision time, and recovery success after failures.
project_ideas.name: Agent Substrate Benchmark
project_ideas.poc: Build a suite of 20 knowledge-work tasks (e.g., drafting and sending email sequences, scheduling with follow-up, research synthesis) and execute them under two architectures: (a) agent as a chat session invoking tools, (b) agent as a bot with its own VM and persistent filesystem. Recruit 10 users to supervise both.
project_ideas.video_title: How we built Grok Bot in a month | Roman Ugarte (SpaceXAI)

project_ideas.based_on: Natural language is used as the automation primitive, deliberately replacing traditional trigger/workflow builders
project_ideas.hypothesis: Compiling natural-language automation instructions into inspectable, editable specs improves reliability and debuggability without reducing adoption by non-technical users.
project_ideas.measurement: Success rate of scheduled executions, time to debug a failed automation, user satisfaction (SUS), and number of edits to compiled specs.
project_ideas.name: NL Automation Compiler
project_ideas.poc: Implement a system that takes plain-English recurring/conditional tasks (e.g., 'remind me at 8 AM daily') and produces a structured schedule that can be viewed, edited, and version-controlled. Test with 15 non-technical users over two weeks.
project_ideas.video_title: How we built Grok Bot in a month | Roman Ugarte (SpaceXAI)

project_ideas.based_on: What authorization and isolation model lets a bot hold long-lived credentials for company tools while remaining auditable and revocable?
project_ideas.hypothesis: Per-bot scoped credentials with mandatory action logs preserve agent autonomy while reducing the blast radius of a compromised agent compared to shared service accounts.
project_ideas.measurement: Scope of unauthorized access, time to revoke credentials, audit log completeness, and task success rate under normal operation.
project_ideas.name: Agent Credential Isolation Prototype
project_ideas.poc: Create a bot with its own identity and scoped tokens for three company tools (e.g., email, calendar, CRM). Simulate a compromised agent (prompt injection) and measure containment. Compare with a bot using a shared admin account.
project_ideas.video_title: How we built Grok Bot in a month | Roman Ugarte (SpaceXAI)

project_ideas.based_on: The team manually onboarded 200-300 users in high-touch sessions
project_ideas.hypothesis: A structured manual onboarding protocol for 20 users yields a failure taxonomy and use-case distribution that automated telemetry misses in the first month of an agent product.
project_ideas.measurement: Number of unique failure modes discovered, number of product decisions changed, and overlap between manual and telemetry findings.
project_ideas.name: Manual Onboarding as Evaluation Harness
project_ideas.poc: Conduct 20 one-hour manual onboarding sessions with target users, logging every failure, confusion, and workaround. Simultaneously collect automated telemetry from the same sessions. Compare the sets of issues discovered.
project_ideas.video_title: How we built Grok Bot in a month | Roman Ugarte (SpaceXAI)

project_ideas.based_on: Epiplexity measures the structural information a *computationally bounded* observer can extract from data
project_ideas.hypothesis: Selecting training data by epiplexity (time-bounded MDL) yields better out-of-distribution generalization than dedup or perplexity filtering at the same compute budget.
project_ideas.measurement: OOD accuracy and achieved compression (bits per token) versus baseline curation methods.
project_ideas.name: Epiplexity-Guided Data Curation
project_ideas.poc: Implement a tractable epiplexity estimator during training; use it to curate subsets of a text/code corpus; train a small model on each subset and compare OOD transfer.
project_ideas.video_title: The Foundations of Modern AI: Generalization, Data Selection, and Epiplexity

project_ideas.based_on: Generalization is achieved not by restricting model capacity but by pairing an expressive hypothesis space with a *soft* preference for compressible solutions
project_ideas.hypothesis: Increasing model capacity while adding a soft compression penalty (e.g., MDL regularization) shrinks the generalization gap more than capacity increase alone at equal data and compute.
project_ideas.measurement: Generalization gap (test minus train loss) as a function of model size, with and without soft bias.
project_ideas.name: Soft Bias Scaling Law
project_ideas.poc: Train models of varying parameter counts with and without a soft compression bias; measure held-out generalization gap and achieved compression.
project_ideas.video_title: The Foundations of Modern AI: Generalization, Data Selection, and Epiplexity

project_ideas.based_on: Sequence direction / factorization order matters empirically even though classical information theory treats information as independent of factorization order
project_ideas.hypothesis: The order in which tool outputs and reasoning steps are serialized into an agent trajectory significantly affects downstream task success and learnability.
project_ideas.measurement: Task success rate and sample efficiency (steps to converge) across orderings.
project_ideas.name: Trajectory Ordering Optimization
project_ideas.poc: Generate agent trajectories with different orderings (e.g., tool calls before vs. after reasoning, context placement) and evaluate task success and training efficiency when fine-tuning on each ordering.
project_ideas.video_title: The Foundations of Modern AI: Generalization, Data Selection, and Epiplexity

project_ideas.based_on: The first information paradox: classical theory says deterministic processes cannot create information (data processing inequality), yet synthetic data generation and pseudorandom generators enable superhuman systems like AlphaZero
project_ideas.hypothesis: Self-play with bounded compute can produce novel extractable structure (strategies, compressed representations) not present in the seed data, contradicting the data processing inequality intuition.
project_ideas.measurement: Performance beyond seed data, and information-theoretic novelty of generated trajectories relative to seed.
project_ideas.name: Self-Play Structure Emergence
project_ideas.poc: Run self-play in a game (e.g., AlphaZero-style) and measure new strategies or compressed representations that outperform the seed data's best.
project_ideas.video_title: The Foundations of Modern AI: Generalization, Data Selection, and Epiplexity

project_ideas.based_on: Adding a meta-harness to Claude Code on Terminal Bench 2 gave an 18% accuracy bump.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Re-running a fixed base agent with a versioned meta-harness on Terminal Bench 2 will reproduce an accuracy improvement large enough that harness version matters more than a typical point-model update.
project_ideas.measurement: Terminal Bench 2 task success rates for each harness variant, with bootstrapped confidence intervals and per-task error deltas.
project_ideas.name: HarnessAttribute
project_ideas.poc: Build a benchmark runner that pins one base agent and toggles only the meta-harness layer, with per-task logs, git-pinned harness versions, and a no-meta-harness control.
project_ideas.video_title: Why The Harness Matters More Than The Model | YC Paper Club

project_ideas.based_on: L2 REPL and Subagents (Agentic Garbage Collection)
project_ideas.hypothesis: Explicit L2 agentic garbage collection via subagent summarization keeps active context token count bounded and preserves or improves task success compared with a no-op context manager on long-horizon coding tasks.
project_ideas.measurement: Context token counts at predefined task milestones, task completion rate, total token cost, and wall-clock time.
project_ideas.name: Agent Memory GC
project_ideas.poc: Instrument an agent runtime to log context growth, then run 20 long-horizon tasks in two modes: default context accumulation versus subagent-based compaction of stale L2 state.
project_ideas.video_title: Why The Harness Matters More Than The Model | YC Paper Club

project_ideas.based_on: Continual learning harnesses allow models to update prompts, tools, and system states iteratively.
project_ideas.hypothesis: A self-modifying harness that tests prompt and tool mutations offline before promotion will improve held-out task success by a meaningful margin over a fixed harness while never regressing below the fixed-harness baseline.
project_ideas.measurement: Average success rate of promoted candidates, number of rollbacks, and score difference on the held-out suite against the fixed-harness control.
project_ideas.name: Harness Auto-Tuner with Rollback
project_ideas.poc: Wrap a task agent with a prompt optimizer that saves each candidate harness state, evaluates it on a held-out suite, and only promotes mutations that pass a regression threshold; keep a rollback registry for all promoted states.
project_ideas.video_title: Why The Harness Matters More Than The Model | YC Paper Club

project_ideas.based_on: As models get better, harnesses need to become more complicated to allow models to do more things
project_ideas.hypothesis: Given a fixed agentic task suite, a measurable subset of harness components (auto-mode classifiers, verification steps, escalation rules) becomes redundant as the underlying model improves, and ablating those components without loss of task success rate identifies removable scaffolding; harness complexity therefore does not need to grow monotonically.
project_ideas.measurement: Marginal task-success contribution and cost delta per harness component per model version; number of components that can be removed with no statistically significant success-rate loss.
project_ideas.name: Harness Ablation Rig
project_ideas.poc: Run the same task suite across two successive model versions with a configurable harness where each component can be toggled; measure success rate, escalation frequency, and cost per task for every harness subset to locate the ablation frontier.
project_ideas.video_title: How Anthropic Builds And How Engineering Will Change Soon | Thariq Shihipar

project_ideas.based_on: Writing 100x more testing code than before
project_ideas.hypothesis: Verification-to-production code ratio scales with machine generation rate rather than human review bandwidth, and pipelines below a threshold ratio exhibit rising defect escape rates that are not detected by human diff review.
project_ideas.measurement: Correlation between verification-to-production ratio and defect escape rate per generation-volume bucket; ratio threshold at which escape rate stops improving.
project_ideas.name: Verification Ratio Meter
project_ideas.poc: Instrument a repo or pipeline to track verification lines, production lines, generation volume, and post-merge defect escapes per time window; plot escape rate against verification-to-production ratio and detect the knee where escapes fall off.
project_ideas.video_title: How Anthropic Builds And How Engineering Will Change Soon | Thariq Shihipar

project_ideas.based_on: Loop engineering involves setting up systems that prompt Claude in automated loops
project_ideas.hypothesis: Recurring agent loops can run unattended only when explicit idempotency keys, triage-item deduplication, per-loop cost ceilings, and a defined escalation path are enforced, and loops missing these properties fail at a predictable task-ambiguity threshold.
project_ideas.measurement: Unattended run success rate, duplicate-action rate, cost per loop run, and the task-ambiguity level at which human escalation becomes mandatory.
project_ideas.name: Loop Ops Harness
project_ideas.poc: Build a scheduled loop runner (cadence trigger plus tag-triggered triage) for a morning-check style job over events and PRs, with toggleable idempotency, dedup, cost ceiling, and escalation controls; escalate task scope and ambiguity until autonomy collapses.
project_ideas.video_title: How Anthropic Builds And How Engineering Will Change Soon | Thariq Shihipar

project_ideas.based_on: Calling MCPs and reading inboxes via artifacts
project_ideas.hypothesis: Model-generated interactive artifacts that invoke MCPs and read data sources leak capability unless permissions are granted per artifact instance, and per-instance capability grants reduce unauthorized tool-call surface without reducing task completion rate.
project_ideas.measurement: Rate of tool calls outside the granted scope, task completion rate, and observability coverage of tool-call provenance per artifact instance.
project_ideas.name: Generated Artifact Capability Sandbox
project_ideas.poc: Wrap generated artifacts in a sandbox where each instance receives an explicit scoped capability manifest for its MCP calls and data reads; compare unauthorized-call incidence and task completion against an unscoped baseline.
project_ideas.video_title: How Anthropic Builds And How Engineering Will Change Soon | Thariq Shihipar

project_ideas.based_on: failure accelerates downward spirals
project_ideas.hypothesis: A sustained increase in the rate of minor error-prone actions predicts task failure earlier and with fewer false positives than a threshold on task success rate.
project_ideas.measurement: Precision, recall, and mean time-to-intervention on labeled runs that spiral versus recover.
project_ideas.name: SpiralWatch
project_ideas.poc: Instrument a suite of agent trajectories with injected avoidable small errors; compare a derivative-based drift detector against an end-threshold detector.
project_ideas.video_title: How To Find Your “Upward Aim” When You Feel Stuck

project_ideas.based_on: Betrayal is placed at the bottom of Dante's hell because it undermines trust, the foundation of community.
project_ideas.hypothesis: In a multi-agent collaborative task, one compromised agent corrupting shared state causes no downstream task failure when shared state is append-only and attested, but causes measurable task failure with mutable shared state.
project_ideas.measurement: Task success rate and number of valid downstream states across 100 runs per condition.
project_ideas.name: LedgerAgent
project_ideas.poc: Build two multi-agent task environments (mutable shared state vs append-only attested ledger); inject one agent that writes forged operation results; compare outcomes.
project_ideas.video_title: How To Find Your “Upward Aim” When You Feel Stuck

project_ideas.based_on: Upward aim transforms daily actions by aligning them with a transcendent moral framework.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Agents whose action selection is checked by a constitution layer will achieve higher cumulative success on a long-horizon task than reward-only agents, despite identical step-level rewards.
project_ideas.measurement: Cumulative success rate over 500 episodes and the amount of short-term reward sacrificed per episode.
project_ideas.name: ConstitutionGuard
project_ideas.poc: Implement a task where local reward is noisy and step-optimal choices conflict with terminal goals; compare an LLM action proposer with and without a constitution-checking filter.
project_ideas.video_title: How To Find Your “Upward Aim” When You Feel Stuck

project_ideas.based_on: Write down past misdeeds and mistakes in detail
project_ideas.hypothesis: Policy updates that include structured self-attribution of the model's own actions in failed episodes reduce repeated same-category failures more than updates using only external outcome labels.
project_ideas.measurement: Rate of same-category failure across held-out evaluation episodes.
project_ideas.name: Confession Auditor
project_ideas.poc: Build an agent benchmark with recurring decision traps; log full traces and, for failures, generate self-critique before fine-tuning; compare against standard supervised learning on successful traces.
project_ideas.video_title: How To Find Your “Upward Aim” When You Feel Stuck

project_ideas.based_on: Humans remain critical ingredients at local maxima to jump to the next hill.
project_ideas.hypothesis: An autonomous coding loop can produce a reliable plateau signal (stagnating PR acceptance, declining self-improvement, or output churn) that triggers a human retargeting event and materially improves outcomes compared with step-by-step human review or random interventions.
project_ideas.measurement: Number of merged PRs, goal attainment per run, cost per merged PR, and precision/recall of the plateau signal against human-labeled plateaus and intervention outcomes.
project_ideas.name: LoopPlateau
project_ideas.poc: Instrument a bug-fix-to-PR agent loop on a set of synthetic and sample repositories; run three policies: no human until plateau signal, human approval at every step, and random human intervention. At plateau, give the human only a retargeting prompt.
project_ideas.video_title: Why companies are becoming a series of loops | Anish Acharya (a16z)

project_ideas.based_on: Company building is becoming a series of creating loops
project_ideas.hypothesis: A minimal loop abstraction with run, measure, plateau, human-retarget, and compose primitives can express both an engineering coding workflow and a growth testing workflow with less bespoke code and clearer fault boundaries than a conventional agent/DAG framework.
project_ideas.measurement: Lines of code required to express each workflow, time to change an objective, number of human interventions per completed task, and parity of output quality with hand-written orchestration.
project_ideas.name: LoopKit
project_ideas.poc: Build LoopKit and implement two parallel workflows: a coding loop (bug-fix to PR to human review) and a growth variant-generation-and-testing loop, each with local optimizer and human bridge.
project_ideas.video_title: Why companies are becoming a series of loops | Anish Acharya (a16z)

project_ideas.based_on: People want to spend time rather than save time
project_ideas.hypothesis: A consumer AI loop optimized for user-reported enjoyment and felt progress will produce higher voluntary return and retention than an equivalent loop optimized for task speed or output quality.
project_ideas.measurement: D7 voluntary return rate, session count, self-reported mood shift, perceived progress, and correlation between task efficiency and retention.
project_ideas.name: DesireLoop
project_ideas.poc: Build a small consumer 'make me happier' loop (e.g., creative generator with reflection) in two variants: one framed around efficiency and task completion, one framed around emotional progress and fun. Run a two-armed study with volunteer users for two weeks.
project_ideas.video_title: Why companies are becoming a series of loops | Anish Acharya (a16z)

project_ideas.based_on: Frontier models are irrationally priced for certain use cases
project_ideas.hypothesis: For at least three recurring loop archetypes (code modification, growth copy testing, and support drafting), a router that selects between frontier and open-weight models based on per-loop quality bands will reduce inference cost by at least 40% while staying within 5% of frontier-model acceptance quality.
project_ideas.measurement: Inference cost per task, task quality pass rate, router agreement with best available model, and end-to-end loop ROI.
project_ideas.name: LoopModelRouter
project_ideas.poc: Run 200 task instances per archetype on frontier and candidate open-weight models, collect proxy quality labels, train a deterministic router on task features, and simulate routing versus all-frontier within end-to-end loop execution.
project_ideas.video_title: Why companies are becoming a series of loops | Anish Acharya (a16z)

project_ideas.based_on: When frontier models saturate high-profile suites like ARC-AGI-3, a static evaluation harness becomes a lagging indicator
project_ideas.hypothesis: A benchmark pipeline that synthesizes new items from a current model's errors will keep the next-version accuracy below 85% on 1,000 generated items, while accuracy on the original frozen ARC-AGI-3-style suite exceeds 98%.
project_ideas.measurement: Accuracy on frozen vs. generated benchmark across model checkpoints; time from model release to saturation.
project_ideas.name: AutoEval Churn Engine
project_ideas.poc: Build an LLM-driven mutator that takes failed tasks from an ARC-style grid benchmark, creates semantically constrained variants, filters them with an automatic difficulty judge, then evaluates the next small model on a 1,000-item generated set.
project_ideas.video_title: GPT-6 Astra Saturates ARC-AGI-3, Tesla Cybercab Hits Austin, Anthropic Proves Fermat's Last Theorem

project_ideas.based_on: Computer-use assistance integrated into a frontier model from the ground up is architecturally different from bolting tool use onto a text model
project_ideas.hypothesis: Intercepting a native CUA model's low-level computer actions and enforcing a reversible-actions-only policy plus user confirmation for high-impact actions will prevent at least 90% of destructive actions while reducing task success by no more than 15% on a 100-task office automation benchmark.
project_ideas.measurement: Policy violations per task, task success rate, human approvals triggered.
project_ideas.name: Action Policy Interceptor for Native CUA
project_ideas.poc: Wrap a CUA-enabled frontier model in a sandboxed VM with a proxy that classifies each action (click, type, file write, network) and allows or blocks it; run the same 100 tasks with and without the interceptor.
project_ideas.video_title: GPT-6 Astra Saturates ARC-AGI-3, Tesla Cybercab Hits Austin, Anthropic Proves Fermat's Last Theorem

project_ideas.based_on: A 30-million-line formalization of Fermat's Last Theorem is evidence that AI-generated mathematical output can move from informal prose to machine-checkable code artifacts
project_ideas.hypothesis: A 10k-line AI-generated formal proof built in a pinned and reproducible environment will show 20% fewer checker failures than the same proof with floating proof-library dependencies, because the extra failures are dependency-induced, not logical.
project_ideas.measurement: Proof-check pass rate and failure category counts across locked vs. floating builds.
project_ideas.name: Proof Reproducibility Checker
project_ideas.poc: Partition an existing machine-generated formal proof into modules with pinned package locks; rebuild under locked and floating dependency sets and run the proof checker on each.
project_ideas.video_title: GPT-6 Astra Saturates ARC-AGI-3, Tesla Cybercab Hits Austin, Anthropic Proves Fermat's Last Theorem

project_ideas.based_on: the agent consumes the repository at scale and generates a specification, pre-compiled code, and PRs before human review of only the final 20%
project_ideas.hypothesis: A review strategy that checks an AI-authored repository-scale change against a generated specification and acceptance tests will catch at least 2x more injected semantic defects per reviewer-hour than a full line-by-line diff review of the same PR.
project_ideas.measurement: Semantic defects discovered per reviewer-hour; false-positive review flags.
project_ideas.name: Spec-Only Review Trial
project_ideas.poc: Create a synthetic codebase and an AI PR implementing a feature with dozens of seeded defects; run two groups of engineers, one reading the full diff and one reviewing spec plus acceptance tests plus the final diff; measure defects found.
project_ideas.video_title: GPT-6 Astra Saturates ARC-AGI-3, Tesla Cybercab Hits Austin, Anthropic Proves Fermat's Last Theorem

project_ideas.based_on: Abstraction should be reframed as context compression
project_ideas.hypothesis: For a fixed token budget, abstractions with higher compression ratios (fewer tokens to represent equivalent functionality) enable agents to solve more complex tasks than lower-compression abstractions.
project_ideas.measurement: Task completion rate, error rate, and tokens-per-functionality as a function of abstraction design.
project_ideas.name: Abstraction Compression Benchmark (ACB)
project_ideas.poc: Build a suite of programming tasks where the same functionality is expressed with different abstraction designs (e.g., monolithic vs. layered APIs), run an agent on each under a fixed context window, measure task success.
project_ideas.video_title: Software Abstraction in the Age of AI-Generated Code - Andrei Alexandrescu - ACCU 2026

project_ideas.based_on: Compilers will be architected for dialog with AI agents
project_ideas.hypothesis: A compiler that exposes a structured, queryable interface (e.g., requesting specific patterns, negotiating refactors) improves agent repair success and reduces token consumption compared to raw diagnostic text.
project_ideas.measurement: Agent task success rate, number of iterations, token usage.
project_ideas.name: Agent-Dialog Compiler Prototype (ADCP)
project_ideas.poc: Build a wrapper around an existing compiler that provides a conversational API (e.g., ask for errors in JSON, request code patterns across versions), integrate with an agent coding loop, compare against baseline.
project_ideas.video_title: Software Abstraction in the Age of AI-Generated Code - Andrei Alexandrescu - ACCU 2026

project_ideas.based_on: review or verify code built on AI-defined abstractions
project_ideas.hypothesis: Provenance and explainability artifacts (e.g., abstraction contracts, intent specs) allow human reviewers to validate AI-defined abstractions with higher accuracy and lower cognitive load than reading generated code directly.
project_ideas.measurement: Bug detection rate, time to review, confidence.
project_ideas.name: AI-Abstraction Review Harness (AARH)
project_ideas.poc: Create a system where AI generates code and also produces an abstraction contract and provenance; human reviewers are asked to spot injected bugs under two conditions: with artifacts vs. without.
project_ideas.video_title: Software Abstraction in the Age of AI-Generated Code - Andrei Alexandrescu - ACCU 2026

project_ideas.based_on: revival of specification languages providing concise intent
project_ideas.hypothesis: Intent-level specifications can regenerate large codebases more reliably (higher fidelity, fewer regressions) than iterating directly on code with AI.
project_ideas.measurement: Regeneration fidelity, test pass rate, human edit effort.
project_ideas.name: Specification-Driven Regeneration Fidelity Check (SDRFC)
project_ideas.poc: Take a codebase, create a concise spec (e.g., Spec++-like), use AI to regenerate code from spec, compare against iterative code editing on metrics like compilation success, test pass rate, edit distance.
project_ideas.video_title: Software Abstraction in the Age of AI-Generated Code - Andrei Alexandrescu - ACCU 2026

project_ideas.based_on: engineering-to-PM ratio is trending down to 2:1 or even 1:1
project_ideas.hypothesis: Adding an explicit versioned product-spec and user-feedback capture layer between product intent and AI code generation reduces the ask-to-validated-feature cycle time more than simply swapping prompt templates or model versions.
project_ideas.measurement: Median time from user request to accepted feature; fraction of rework caused by spec drift; number of iterations to meet acceptance criteria.
project_ideas.name: SpecCycle harness
project_ideas.poc: Instrument a small application where user requests enter a spec queue; an AI drafts acceptance criteria and code from the spec; user feedback updates the spec; measure repeated build-validate loops.
project_ideas.video_title: Prompting Is Dead in 6 Months. Andrew Ng, Stanford

project_ideas.based_on: Every time you build something with AI, you take on technical debt
project_ideas.hypothesis: AI-generated PRs that are merged without automated tests, documentation, and an ownership tag become 2x more likely to require defect-fixing changes within 90 days than generated PRs that pass those gates.
project_ideas.measurement: Change frequency, defect density, refactoring cost, and time-to-repair for compliant vs. non-compliant AI-generated modules.
project_ideas.name: DebtGate
project_ideas.poc: Build a pre-merge bot for a repository using AI code generation that flags PRs where generated code lacks test coverage, doc signatures, or assigned maintainer; tag such PRs as unreviewed debt.
project_ideas.video_title: Prompting Is Dead in 6 Months. Andrew Ng, Stanford

project_ideas.based_on: persistent demographic biases
project_ideas.hypothesis: A fixed prompt sweep across demographic descriptors and contexts will surface stereotype patterns that standard safety-filter evaluation misses, making it a reliable regression signal for model releases.
project_ideas.measurement: Stereotype-score distribution, disproportionality across groups, and number of unsafe-by-bias cases that pass a safety-filter-only gate.
project_ideas.name: BiasSweep regression suite
project_ideas.poc: Create a small test harness that samples generated images across a grid of demographic and contextual prompts; score outputs for stereotype proportionality and demographic consistency; run it in CI.
project_ideas.video_title: Prompting Is Dead in 6 Months. Andrew Ng, Stanford

project_ideas.based_on: Wiki pages can have scopes that users can control deterministically
project_ideas.hypothesis: Query-time scope filtering on a shared context store leaks scoped content into lower-privilege contexts at a measurable nonzero rate via summarization and embedding retrieval, while index-time partitioning does not, and the gap is large enough to be a release blocker rather than a rounding error.
project_ideas.measurement: Leakage rate (recovered protected facts per 100 queries) per filter placement and per probe type, plus the false-exclusion rate showing how much legitimate context index-time partitioning costs.
project_ideas.name: Scope-Leak Harness
project_ideas.poc: Build a synthetic company wiki with tiered-scope pages, two retrieval modes (index-time partition vs. query-time filter), and three leak probes: top-k direct retrieval, summarization over mixed-privilege results, and nearest-neighbor reconstruction from embedding indexes; run each probe as a low-privilege caller and attempt to recover protected facts.
project_ideas.video_title: Your company brain will leak secrets: how we stopped it for big banks — Tanmai Gopal, PromptQL

project_ideas.based_on: Inject user credentials at the HTTP/SQL layer dynamically based on the initiating user's identity
project_ideas.hypothesis: An identity-aware credential-injecting proxy in front of HTTP/SQL tools can be induced to execute a call with a higher privilege than the initiating caller's identity in at least one of three patterns: replayed session binding, nested tool call inheriting the prior caller, or scope-confusion in a mediated call whose target is attacker-influenced.
project_ideas.measurement: Number of adversarial traces producing a successful high-privilege call, classified by pattern, and the minimum proxy hardening change that drives each pattern to zero.
project_ideas.name: Confused-Deputy Injection Proxy Red Team
project_ideas.poc: Stand up a minimal injection proxy that resolves credentials per call from a caller identity token, wrap a mock high-privilege data API behind it, and run a suite of adversarial agent traces (prompt-injected nested calls, session-replay, target-rewrite) against it.
project_ideas.video_title: Your company brain will leak secrets: how we stopped it for big banks — Tanmai Gopal, PromptQL

project_ideas.based_on: Agents should not auto-add memory or wiki pages without human confirmation
project_ideas.hypothesis: At sustained volume above roughly 100 agent-proposed memory additions per day, human confirmation of scoped wiki additions degrades measurably — reviewer dwell time collapses and the unreviewed-or-auto-approved merge fraction rises — even though the pipeline's stated design requires genuine confirmation.
project_ideas.measurement: Median review dwell time, edits-per-merge, rejection rate, and the slope of auto-approval as a function of daily proposal volume; flag the volume at which dwell time drops below a threshold indicating nominal review.
project_ideas.name: Review-at-Scale Memory Pipeline
project_ideas.poc: Instrument a propose-scope-confirm-merge pipeline with synthetic but realistic agent suggestions at 10, 50, 150 and 300 additions/day, recording dwell time, edit-before-merge rate, and rejection rate per volume tier.
project_ideas.video_title: Your company brain will leak secrets: how we stopped it for big banks — Tanmai Gopal, PromptQL

project_ideas.based_on: Wiki contributions per day increasing steadily from 0 to over 300 updates per day over a two-month period
project_ideas.hypothesis: Rising daily wiki update volume is a noisy proxy for brain health: above some threshold, marginal updates correlate with duplication and contradiction in the context store and with flat or declining agent task success, not with improved success.
project_ideas.measurement: Correlation between weekly update volume and agent task success rate, plus duplication and contradiction density in the store; report whether success improves, plateaus, or degrades past a volume inflection.
project_ideas.name: Update-Rate vs. Task-Outcome Study
project_ideas.poc: Run a longitudinal instrumented deployment (or a simulated one seeded with the reported 0-to-300+ updates/day trajectory) that logs update rate alongside context-store duplication/contradiction metrics and a fixed agent task suite's success and error rates.
project_ideas.video_title: Your company brain will leak secrets: how we stopped it for big banks — Tanmai Gopal, PromptQL

project_ideas.based_on: Running an LLM agent is fundamentally a search problem
project_ideas.hypothesis: For a fixed agent task, improving context placement and retrieval tooling yields at least a 30% relative task-success improvement equal to or greater than spending the same engineering budget on prompt engineering.
project_ideas.measurement: Task success rate, context-window fill efficiency, and latency/cost per engineering-hour invested.
project_ideas.name: Context Placement Harness
project_ideas.poc: Build a benchmark around a tool-using agent, comparing variants with (a) sophisticated retrieval/index/context selectors and (b) prompt refinements; keep the underlying model constant and track expected engineering hours.
project_ideas.video_title: Agents' next frontier: agent-to-agent and network effects — Jean-Denis Greze, Town

project_ideas.based_on: returns a relationship strength score without exposing raw conversation content
project_ideas.hypothesis: An agent using a relationship-strength score API can answer referral/interaction questions within 5 percentage points of an agent with raw corporate email access, while exposing zero raw email content to the model.
project_ideas.measurement: Task accuracy, number/size of raw content leaks sent to the model, and user trust/explanation quality.
project_ideas.name: Signal-Score Cross-Silo API
project_ideas.poc: Create a synthetic email corpus and a cross-silo tool that computes a relationship score per pair; run two agents side-by-side: one with the signal API and one with raw corpus search.
project_ideas.video_title: Agents' next frontier: agent-to-agent and network effects — Jean-Denis Greze, Town

project_ideas.based_on: low-sensitivity zones
project_ideas.hypothesis: A policy engine that automatically classifies agent actions into low-sensitivity/low-risk zones can reduce manual approval load by at least 80% without increasing policy-violation rate beyond an allowed audit threshold.
project_ideas.measurement: Manual review reduction, false-approval/violation rate, escalation rate in higher-sensitivity zones.
project_ideas.name: Sensitivity-Zone Auto-Approval Engine
project_ideas.poc: Instrument a development-workflow agent to request permission gates; train/use a classifier on action metadata and PII/data-sensitivity indicators; run in shadow mode against human approvals for N=2,000 actions.
project_ideas.video_title: Agents' next frontier: agent-to-agent and network effects — Jean-Denis Greze, Town

project_ideas.based_on: AI has changed the startup landscape by introducing massive GPU and token costs.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Exposing per-step inference cost in an agent orchestration layer and routing easy intents through cheap models reduces cost per successful task by at least 30% without lowering pass rate on a fixed evaluation set.
project_ideas.measurement: Cost per successful task on a fixed set of 500 tasks; success rate; p50 and p95 latency before and after routing.
project_ideas.name: Cost-First Orchestration with a Token Ledger
project_ideas.poc: Build a proxy around an existing agent that logs tokens consumed at every step and inserts a fast intent classifier to send easy tasks to a small model while complex tasks continue to the frontier model.
project_ideas.video_title: Paul Graham On Startups, Ambition, and Great Founders

project_ideas.based_on: Early AI models felt like an undergraduate struggling through a paper, but capabilities have evolved rapidly.
project_ideas.hypothesis: An agent whose control logic is isolated behind a model abstraction layer will show less than 5% behavioral regression after swapping to a newer model generation, while the same workflow with model-specific prompt patches will regress more than 20%.
project_ideas.measurement: Behavioral pass rate before and after model substitution; number of workflow failures; lines of code changed to accommodate the new model.
project_ideas.name: Model-Swap Regression Suite
project_ideas.poc: Implement a common document-extraction workflow twice: once with a version-agnostic model interface and once with direct model calls and instance-specific workarounds. Run both against two consecutive model versions.
project_ideas.video_title: Paul Graham On Startups, Ambition, and Great Founders

project_ideas.based_on: Technology often starts by imitating simple narrow functions (like a fly's brain) and scales up to complex human capabilities
project_ideas.hypothesis: A customer-support assistant deployed first as narrow perfect intent handlers will show a lower high-severity failure rate in its first month than the same broad assistant launched with a general prompt and full tool access on day one.
project_ideas.measurement: High-severity failure rate per 100 completed tasks; rate of human-like plausible-but-wrong outputs; cost per successful task.
project_ideas.name: Fly-to-Human Staged Deployment Harness
project_ideas.poc: Create two variants of an internal triage agent. Variant A has one broad prompt with unrestricted tools; variant B uses a deterministic router to fixed narrow handlers. Run both on identical task queues and record failures.
project_ideas.video_title: Paul Graham On Startups, Ambition, and Great Founders

project_ideas.based_on: The first 15 to 17 years of a founder's life shape their character and resilience.
project_ideas.hypothesis: If two agent models are matched on current benchmark performance, the model whose history includes documented adversarial fine-tuning and recovery traces will have at least a 20% lower failure rate on novel task disruptions than the model without such history.
project_ideas.measurement: Failure-rate delta on a shifted-task suite at equivalent baseline performance.
project_ideas.name: Provenance-Card Evaluator
project_ideas.poc: Take an open-weights base model; produce model A with standard SFT and model B with SFT plus adversarial stress-tuning and self-recovery record; select checkpoints so that baseline benchmarks match; run both on held-out shifted tasks.
project_ideas.video_title: Former Sequoia Chairman Michael Moritz on Founders: "It's About the First 15 or 16 Years of Life"

project_ideas.based_on: Google was perceived as a late entry into search.
project_ideas.hypothesis: An agent built behind a model-agnostic internal API can swap from an incumbent model to a late-entrant model in under one working day and improve task success by at least 15% without any changes to planning or tool logic.
project_ideas.measurement: Swap lead time in hours and percent task-success improvement on an agentic benchmark.
project_ideas.name: Late-Entrant Adapter Benchmark
project_ideas.poc: Implement a minimal agent with internal API and adapter; run on incumbent model A; swap to late-entrant model B using the same adapter; run the same agentic task suite before and after the swap.
project_ideas.video_title: Former Sequoia Chairman Michael Moritz on Founders: "It's About the First 15 or 16 Years of Life"

project_ideas.based_on: Webvan was a colossal mistake where Sequoia lost 44 million dollars.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Gating scale-out on infrastructure-readiness thresholds (e.g., cost per successful task below a threshold, tool success rate above a threshold, observability coverage above a threshold) reduces cumulative capital wasted by at least 30% compared with un-gated rollout.
project_ideas.measurement: Wasted compute dollars; cumulative loss; time to positive unit economics in gated vs un-gated modes.
project_ideas.name: Readiness-Gated Agent Spend
project_ideas.poc: Build a lightweight middleware gate that blocks concurrency increases when readiness metadata is below threshold; simulate gated vs un-gated rollouts on the same task mix under synthetic infrastructure-maturity curves.
project_ideas.video_title: Former Sequoia Chairman Michael Moritz on Founders: "It's About the First 15 or 16 Years of Life"

project_ideas.based_on: Bad decisions come from imperfect data, overcomplicating things, and failing to do proper homework.
project_ideas.hypothesis: An evaluation harness that pre-checks dataset contamination, duplicate examples, and label ambiguity surfaces as many defect classes as a complex multi-stage orchestration while reducing mean time-to-debug by at least 50%.
project_ideas.measurement: Defect-detection recall and mean time-to-debug in each harness.
project_ideas.name: Data-Quality-First Eval Harness
project_ideas.poc: Run the same set of deliberately defective agent tasks through (a) a linear data-quality-gated harness and (b) a multi-step orchestrated harness; compare defect discoveries and debugging traces.
project_ideas.video_title: Former Sequoia Chairman Michael Moritz on Founders: "It's About the First 15 or 16 Years of Life"

project_ideas.based_on: When generation becomes cheap, verification and curation become the rate-limiting step
project_ideas.hypothesis: An automated triage layer (novelty scoring, deduplication, correctness pre-checks, quality ranking) can increase human curation throughput of AI-generated mathematical proofs by at least 3x compared to unranked output, without increasing the rate of missed critical errors.
project_ideas.measurement: Time to curate a fixed set of proofs, number of critical errors missed, human curator satisfaction.
project_ideas.name: Proof Triage Engine
project_ideas.poc: Build a pipeline that ingests AI-generated proof candidates, applies automated novelty and correctness heuristics, ranks and clusters them, and presents them to human curators in a prioritized queue. Measure curation time and error detection rate.
project_ideas.video_title: The paradox at the heart of AI and science | Terence Tao

project_ideas.based_on: AI-generated artifacts can be correct in outcome yet unexplainable, producing operational fragility
project_ideas.hypothesis: Capturing intermediate reasoning steps (e.g., chain-of-thought, tool calls, intermediate lemmas) as structured provenance at generation time enables debugging of incorrect AI-generated proofs that would otherwise be opaque, reducing time-to-diagnose by at least 50%.
project_ideas.measurement: Time to identify the faulty step in a proof with provenance vs. without, on a set of known-buggy generated proofs.
project_ideas.name: Provenance Capture for AI Derivations
project_ideas.poc: Instrument an LLM proof generator to log all intermediate steps, store them as a provenance graph, and build a debugger interface. Compare diagnosis time for erroneous proofs with and without provenance.
project_ideas.video_title: The paradox at the heart of AI and science | Terence Tao

project_ideas.based_on: Goal-directed AI acts like a helicopter: it delivers the researcher directly to the target without teaching the route
project_ideas.hypothesis: An AI research agent that explicitly records and surfaces off-target observations and dead ends can produce a higher rate of unexpected but valuable findings (measured by expert novelty ratings) than a purely goal-directed agent, without unacceptable loss in goal attainment speed.
project_ideas.measurement: Number of expert-rated 'unexpected valuable findings' per task, goal completion time.
project_ideas.name: Serendipity-Preserving Agent
project_ideas.poc: Develop two agents: one goal-only, one goal-plus-peripheral-capture. Run both on a set of open-ended scientific exploration tasks. Collect all outputs, have experts rate unexpectedness and value.
project_ideas.video_title: The paradox at the heart of AI and science | Terence Tao

project_ideas.based_on: AI models excel at pattern matching within their training distribution but may fail to extrapolate
project_ideas.hypothesis: Current LLM proof generators fail on out-of-distribution mathematical problems at a significantly higher rate than on in-distribution problems, revealing reliance on pattern matching rather than mechanistic reasoning.
project_ideas.measurement: Accuracy on OOD vs. ID benchmarks, with correlation to problem similarity to training data.
project_ideas.name: Extrapolation Stress Test for Mathematical LLMs
project_ideas.poc: Create a benchmark of mathematical problems that are structurally novel but solvable with known techniques. Evaluate several LLMs. Compare success rates to standard benchmarks.
project_ideas.video_title: The paradox at the heart of AI and science | Terence Tao

project_ideas.based_on: Even having a mobile phone visible in a room creates subconscious cognitive load and reduces focus capacity.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Holding token count constant, removing unused high-salience tool notifications from the active reasoning context before a difficult task improves task accuracy by at least 10% compared to leaving them in contex.
project_ideas.measurement: Task accuracy, attention entropy over active tokens, and number of redundant tool calls before task completion.
project_ideas.name: Context-Room Eviction: Invisible Phone Benchmark
project_ideas.poc: Build a controlled benchmark pair from a hard long-horizon reasoning task; in the treatment, stale tool outputs and system reminders are moved out of the active context into an external index, while baseline keeps them in-context; both have the same non-distractor token budget.
project_ideas.video_title: Andrew Huberman: My Exact Routine To Optimize Brain & Body, I Do All Of These Every Day!

project_ideas.based_on: Side sleeping enhances glymphatic clearance of metabolic waste products from the brain.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Agents that consolidate state during an explicit offline stage after each session retain at least 15% more key facts after 100 turns than agents that compress only when the token limit is reached.
project_ideas.measurement: Fact recall accuracy, contamination or stale-artifact reuse rate, and peak active context length.
project_ideas.name: Sleep-Compactor for Multi-Session Memory
project_ideas.poc: Implement a memory subsystem with an end-of-cycle hook; run a long-horizon benchmark with two arms: one performs 'sleep' compaction (prune low-signal, promote high-value memories) and one no-ops until forced token-limit truncation; compare downstream fact recall.
project_ideas.video_title: Andrew Huberman: My Exact Routine To Optimize Brain & Body, I Do All Of These Every Day!

project_ideas.based_on: Physiological sighs immediately offload carbon dioxide and slow heart rate.
project_ideas.hypothesis: On unexpected agent errors, invoking a minimal context rollback and retry before starting diagnostic reasoning reduces recovery failure loops by at least 20% compared with starting full diagnostics immediately.
project_ideas.measurement: Recovery success rate, mean steps to successful recovery, and error-trace length consumed before the final solution.
project_ideas.name: Sigh-Reset Error Handler for Agents
project_ideas.poc: Instrument an agentic coding framework with a deterministic error injection suite; baseline path runs deep trace analysis on the current disturbed context; treatment path executes a rehearsed reset primitive that truncates the noisy recent context and retries once before deep analysis.
project_ideas.video_title: Andrew Huberman: My Exact Routine To Optimize Brain & Body, I Do All Of These Every Day!

project_ideas.based_on: Cardio and resistance training prime the brain for optimal learning and neuroplasticity in the subsequent hours.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Inserting a deliberately hard, low-stakes warmup task immediately before a learning block outperforms dependency-only task ordering, yielding at least 10% better performance on downstream held-out tasks.
project_ideas.measurement: Downstream task accuracy, learning curve area, and computational steps or prompts used.
project_ideas.name: Morning-Prime Warmup for Ordered Learning
project_ideas.poc: Implement a task pipeline with two scheduling conditions: standard dependency-based order and a 'primed' order that runs a high-effort activation task just before the encoding/learning segment; compare on a few-shot benchmark with held-out tasks.
project_ideas.video_title: Andrew Huberman: My Exact Routine To Optimize Brain & Body, I Do All Of These Every Day!

project_ideas.based_on: Ablates misaligned features during training and fine-tuning to prevent emergent misalignment.
project_ideas.hypothesis: When an LLM is fine-tuned on a narrow, potentially misaligning corpus, ablating the detected misaligned concept during fine-tuning yields a lower external safety-eval misalignment rate than standard fine-tuning.
project_ideas.measurement: Safety eval score on a held-out adversarial set; target concept removal fidelity; code task accuracy delta.
project_ideas.name: CAFT-Guard: Fine-tuning gate with concept ablation
project_ideas.poc: Fine-tune two identical models on an insecure-code corpus: one baseline and one with an SAE-identified misaligned feature ablated per training step; compare downstream safety evaluations and code utility scores.
project_ideas.video_title: Strange Geometric Shapes Found Inside AIs — Tom McGrath

project_ideas.based_on: Using interpretability features as reward signals to supervise open-ended tasks and reduce hallucinations.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Adding a sparse-autoencoder-derived truthfulness feature as a reward signal to an RL fine-tuning loop reduces hallucination on held-out prompts compared with an identical loop using only a task reward.
project_ideas.measurement: Hallucination rate on unseen generation tasks; reward hacking frequency measured by probe divergence from initial feature geometry.
project_ideas.name: FeatureReward: Using SAE probes in RL fine-tuning
project_ideas.poc: Fine-tune a small generative model on a public QA task; train an SAE on layer activations; define a probe reward based on the truthfulness feature; report RL comparison with and without probe reward.
project_ideas.video_title: Strange Geometric Shapes Found Inside AIs — Tom McGrath

project_ideas.based_on: Concepts inside neural networks are organized into geometric structures or manifolds rather than flat, unstructured spaces.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Steering an LLM along a concept manifold direction produces significantly larger intended semantic shifts than an equal-norm random activation direction, while keeping perplexity within a bounded margin of baseline.
project_ideas.measurement: Semantic classifier agreement difference between steered and unsteered outputs; perplexity difference; cosine distance from original prompt embedding.
project_ideas.name: ManifoldPilot: Activation-space steering interface
project_ideas.poc: Train an SAE on a 7B model, locate day-of-week or formality manifold directions, and expose an endpoint that adds the direction vector to layer activations at generation time in head-to-head tests vs prompt-only steering.
project_ideas.video_title: Strange Geometric Shapes Found Inside AIs — Tom McGrath

project_ideas.based_on: We should be able to speedrun science once we have agents that can do experimental work.
project_ideas.hypothesis: An LLM-driven agent can discover a known geometric feature (e.g., day-of-week direction) in a transformer using autonomously generated hypothesis-intervention-measure loops with fewer trials than random search over activation directions.
project_ideas.measurement: Time-to-discovery, number of steering interventions, success rate against ground-truth SAE direction, and agent report quality.
project_ideas.name: AutoInterp: Agentic speedrun harness for feature discovery
project_ideas.poc: Build a harness exposing activation sampling, random direction steering, and classification-based outcome metrics to an agent; instruct it to find a direction that shifts day-of-week classification; run repeated trials on a small open-weight transformer.
project_ideas.video_title: Strange Geometric Shapes Found Inside AIs — Tom McGrath

project_ideas.based_on: Claude 5 models perform best when given the complete task specification upfront.
project_ideas.hypothesis: For a fixed set of long-horizon tasks, one-shot whole-job prompting achieves at least equal objective task success while consuming fewer interaction tokens and user turns than step-by-step decomposition prompting.
project_ideas.measurement: Task completion rate per condition, tokens per successful task, user edit/correction count.
project_ideas.name: SpecBench
project_ideas.poc: Build a task suite from real-world long-horizon jobs; run each condition on the same model; score outputs against objective criteria automatically and log token/metadata.
project_ideas.video_title: Anthropic Just Revealed 7 New Rules for Prompting Claude 5 Models

project_ideas.based_on: Investing time in pre-planning saves tokens and prevents endless iteration cycles.
project_ideas.hypothesis: A harness that triggers an interview phase only when model-predicted task ambiguity exceeds a threshold will reduce total user interaction time and token spend compared to both no-interview and always-interview policies.
project_ideas.measurement: Mean time-to-completion, retries per task, user satisfaction score, tokens consumed.
project_ideas.name: AmbiguityRouter
project_ideas.poc: Build a thin orchestrator in front of a long-horizon model: it asks the model to score ambiguity, then conditionally emits clarifying questions before generating the full task spec.
project_ideas.video_title: Anthropic Just Revealed 7 New Rules for Prompting Claude 5 Models

project_ideas.based_on: Defining exact exit criteria prevents token burning.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Injecting machine-checkable exit criteria derived from the user's 'done means' into the system prompt will reduce token overspend from over-delivery without reducing user-rated completion quality.
project_ideas.measurement: Token consumption per run, overrun rate (work beyond done), user-rated quality score.
project_ideas.name: DoneShield
project_ideas.poc: In an agent loop, parse the task spec for explicit exit predicates, expose them to the model and to a scheduler that checks for early stopping, then compare against a baseline with no exit guard.
project_ideas.video_title: Anthropic Just Revealed 7 New Rules for Prompting Claude 5 Models

project_ideas.based_on: Users need to be able to inspect assumptions, intermediate calculations, and source provenance easily.
project_ideas.hypothesis: When users are shown an AI data answer with assumption breakdown, intermediate calculations, and a notebook link, time-to-verification and correct acceptance rate improves by at least 50% over a zero-context answer-only UI.
project_ideas.measurement: Time-to-verification (seconds), correct acceptance rate, false-acceptance rate, and number of user clicks on source artifacts.
project_ideas.name: VeriTracer: notebook-dossier answers for data agents
project_ideas.poc: Enhance a simple Q/A data agent to emit a Runme-compatible notebook (assumptions, steps, source links) as its output; A/B test with domain analysts on real business questions.
project_ideas.video_title: Stop Shipping AI Nobody Can Verify with Hamel Husain

project_ideas.based_on: Transition failure matrices showing state-to-state failures in agent workflows.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Recording agent state-to-state transitions and computing a failure matrix will surface the highest-frequency failure transition with 3x fewer logs examined than random manual trace search.
project_ideas.measurement: Precision/recall of detected hotspot transition vs. ground-truth from manual log review; reduction in failure rate after focused fix.
project_ideas.name: AgentFailMapper
project_ideas.poc: Build a thin tracing layer around an agent framework (e.g., LangGraph) that logs states/transitions, aggregates failure rates into matrices, and produces ranked hotspot lists.
project_ideas.video_title: Stop Shipping AI Nobody Can Verify with Hamel Husain

project_ideas.based_on: Active learning by surfacing low-confidence examples to human annotators.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Low-confidence surfacing of agent traces will identify novel error categories at least 1.5x faster per annotation hour than random sampling during initial eval-set construction.
project_ideas.measurement: Novel error categories discovered per hour, annotation time, learner accuracy before/after labels, error coverage.
project_ideas.name: EvalLens Active-learning sampler
project_ideas.poc: Implement a small tool that scores raw agent traces by confidence, selects top-N for human review, and periodically feeds findings into a structured eval set; run on a realistic batch of traces.
project_ideas.video_title: Stop Shipping AI Nobody Can Verify with Hamel Husain

project_ideas.based_on: WebMCP allows browser-based applications to expose tools directly to AI agents without server backends.
project_ideas.hypothesis: A WebMCP browser-native tool exposure for a standard app can match a server-backend API on task success rate while cutting integration boilerplate in half, though with an additional measurable per-action failure rate due to browser context.
project_ideas.measurement: Task success rate, lines of integration code/time, per-action failure rate, and browser-layer exception rate.
project_ideas.name: Browser-API parity testbed for WebMCP
project_ideas.poc: Stand up one common web app (e.g., a collaborative spreadsheet UI) and create two tool endpoints (WebMCP and HTTP server API). Run same set of agent tasks against both and compare.
project_ideas.video_title: Stop Shipping AI Nobody Can Verify with Hamel Husain

project_ideas.based_on: Four different prototype iterations of a sales report query yielding inconsistent timeframes, data formats, and layouts.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Repeated identical natural-language queries rendered through a slot-constrained declarative pipeline produce measurably lower layout/semantic variance than the same queries rendered through an unconstrained LLM-to-JSON pipeline.
project_ideas.measurement: Normalized structural edit distance between rendered layouts, semantic field agreement for timeframes/data formats, and invalid-component rate per mode.
project_ideas.name: LayoutDrift: A reproducibility harness for intent-driven interfaces
project_ideas.poc: Instrument a dashboard generator that renders the same KPI request N times under two modes: unconstrained LLM dashboard generation vs. generation constrained by a slot/sub-slot skeleton and component catalog; compare the resulting component trees and datasets.
project_ideas.video_title: The End of the Static Screen: Architecting Intent-Driven UX — Gus Iwanaga, commercetools

project_ideas.based_on: The component catalog is a machine-consumed contract between the agent and the UI
project_ideas.hypothesis: For a fixed set of intents and components, a schema-validated component catalog reduces invalid or off-brand generated UI (design-token violations, invalid props, disallowed component combinations) compared to a prose-only catalog of the same component set.
project_ideas.measurement: Proportion of generated UI trees that fail validation: missing required props, disallowed component types, design-token violations, and out-of-slot placements.
project_ideas.name: CatalogGuard: Schema-validation enforcement for agent-generated UI
project_ideas.poc: Build two catalogs for the same mock design system—one described only in prompting prose, one expressed as JSON schemas with slot constraints—and use each to generate the same set of user-intent dashboards from an LLM.
project_ideas.video_title: The End of the Static Screen: Architecting Intent-Driven UX — Gus Iwanaga, commercetools

project_ideas.based_on: no decision procedure is given for a heterogeneous application
project_ideas.hypothesis: A transparent rubric based on task criticality, intent variability, third-party trust, and compliance sensitivity can recommend Controlled, Declarative, or Open-Ended rendering with high agreement against expert judgments on real B2B workflows.
project_ideas.measurement: Cohen's kappa between rubric recommendation and expert majority, plus a qualitative audit of disagreement cases to refine the rubric.
project_ideas.name: RenderProtocol Advisor: Rubric-based matching of workflows to UI rendering protocols
project_ideas.poc: Define a 5-question rubric, score 10 B2B commerce UI surfaces from the Mosaic-style reporting domain, ask an expert panel to independently assign a protocol, and compare recommendations via agreement metrics.
project_ideas.video_title: The End of the Static Screen: Architecting Intent-Driven UX — Gus Iwanaga, commercetools

project_ideas.based_on: PayPal's approval token carries amount, merchant, and expiry information in an opaque string approved by PayPal.
project_ideas.hypothesis: An agent checkout system armed with amount/merchant/time-bound approval tokens rejects out-of-bound redirections (different merchant, higher amount, expired token) 100% of the time in a black-box test suite, while allowing in-bound changes without human re-approval.
project_ideas.measurement: Rejection rate for out-of-bound attempts; count of valid transactions blocked (false positives); end-to-end latency of token validation.
project_ideas.name: MandateScopeGuard
project_ideas.poc: Build a minimal mandate server issuing opaque signed tokens, a mock agent performing checkout attempts with mutations, and an enforcement middleware; run randomized attacks against the token boundary.
project_ideas.video_title: Your Agent Just Authorized What?! — Jay Mok & Ben Coumes, Paypal

project_ideas.based_on: When parties are unknown and stakes are high, the industry should converge on FIDO verifiable intents and AP2 mandates.
project_ideas.hypothesis: In a realistic local agent checkout loop, FIDO verifiable-intent generation plus AP2 mandate verification adds less than 150 ms to p95 latency compared to an OAuth-vault baseline on commodity hardware.
project_ideas.measurement: p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput, failure rate, and CPU overhead per mode.
project_ideas.name: CredentialLatencyBench
project_ideas.poc: Instrument a test harness that runs the same checkout transaction against three modes: OAuth access token, shared-vault token, and FIDO+AP2 signed mandate; measure timing for 10k iterations.
project_ideas.video_title: Your Agent Just Authorized What?! — Jay Mok & Ben Coumes, Paypal

project_ideas.based_on: Autonomous payments require a multi-layer disclosure architecture involving a trustworthy credential provider, user instructions signed with private keys, and agent authorization tokens.
project_ideas.hypothesis: A child agent acting under a parent's signed verifiable intent can be constrained by a delegation certificate such that every hop is provably in-scope, and any out-of-scope child action fails verification without human re-consent at the intermediate hop.
project_ideas.measurement: Verification success/failure rate; ability to localize the first out-of-scope node in a synthetic delegation chain; time to validate chains of varying depth.
project_ideas.name: DelegationChainProof
project_ideas.poc: Extend a verifiable-intent store with delegation tokens: parent issues a bounded delegation to child, child acts, verifier checks scope set intersection and chain signatures; simulate delegation networks.
project_ideas.video_title: Your Agent Just Authorized What?! — Jay Mok & Ben Coumes, Paypal

project_ideas.based_on: How do users express consent for an action the agent itself determines, when they never write the specific intent?
project_ideas.hypothesis: Non-expert users can accurately approve or reject machine-predicted action intents in a signed-intent review UI, achieving at least 95% agreement with a domain-expert ground truth on a 50-intent test set.
project_ideas.measurement: User agreement rate, time-to-approve, and self-reported confidence compared to expert labels.
project_ideas.name: IntentSignReview
project_ideas.poc: Design a review interface showing a machine-predicted intent (action, counterparty, amount, reason) and a single approve/reject button that triggers a FIDO signature; test with representative tasks.
project_ideas.video_title: Your Agent Just Authorized What?! — Jay Mok & Ben Coumes, Paypal

project_ideas.based_on: writing custom kernels, quantization, and decoding paths
project_ideas.hypothesis: An agentic synthesize-benchmark-revise loop gated by differential testing will find a GPU kernel for a representative inference operator that is at least 1.5x faster than the serving stack's baseline kernel while keeping numerical error below a high-precision reference tolerance.
project_ideas.measurement: Speedup over baseline kernel; numerical error of accepted candidates; percentage of proposals that compile, pass correctness, and improve; GPU-hours consumed.
project_ideas.name: Kernel-Reason: Agentic Kernel Search with Correctness Gates
project_ideas.poc: Construct a sandboxed harness that prompts an LLM to emit low-level GPU kernel implementations for a hot inference operator, compiles and runs each candidate, checks outputs against a high-precision reference over random and adversarial shapes, benchmarks latency, and feeds pass/fail and timing signals into subsequent LLM proposals for 20 iterations.
project_ideas.video_title: Building AI That Optimizes AI

project_ideas.based_on: Where is the empirical ceiling for agentic optimization
project_ideas.hypothesis: Adding a roofline-based stopping rule to an agentic kernel search preserves at least 80% of the best-found speedup while using less than half the GPU-hours of an unbounded search.
project_ideas.measurement: Best speedup relative to baseline; GPU-hours consumed; measured performance as a fraction of roofline peak; reproducibility across two different operators.
project_ideas.name: Roofline Stop-Guard
project_ideas.poc: Take the kernel-search harness and run two arms on the same operator and GPU: an unbounded agent loop for 20 proposals and an agent loop with a roofline upper-bound stop rule. Log every candidate's speedup and elapsed GPU time.
project_ideas.video_title: Building AI That Optimizes AI

project_ideas.based_on: How transferable is an agent-optimized kernel or runtime across models
project_ideas.hypothesis: A frozen recipe of agent-generated kernels and quantization from one open-weight model transfers at least 60% of its bespoke speedup to a same-family model, but transfers less than 20% speedup to a different-architecture model of similar size.
project_ideas.measurement: Transfer ratio equal to frozen-recipe speedup divided by bespoke speedup on each target; acceptance rate of kernels; GPU-hours avoided by reuse.
project_ideas.name: Optimization Transfer Probe
project_ideas.poc: Select three open-weight LLM checkpoints across two architectures and a shared operator suite. Run the agentic optimizer on the reference checkpoint to produce a frozen kernel/quantization recipe, apply that frozen recipe to all three checkpoints, then run bespoke optimization on each as a control arm.
project_ideas.video_title: Building AI That Optimizes AI

project_ideas.based_on: Latency improvement, quantified per inference call, drives enterprise vendor switching
project_ideas.hypothesis: A standardized variable-concurrency load test measuring time-to-first-token and per-request cost can reproduce observable 30-50% provider differences for a voice-agent workload with less than 10% test-retest variance.
project_ideas.measurement: Median and p95 time-to-first-token, sustained throughput, cost per 1,000 calls, and coefficient of variation across repeated runs.
project_ideas.name: Per-Call Latency Contract Probe
project_ideas.poc: Implement a parameterized benchmark client that replays a voice-agent-style request trace against two inference providers serving the same or comparable open model, varying concurrency and context length over repeated controlled sessions.
project_ideas.video_title: Building AI That Optimizes AI

project_ideas.based_on: per-item admission stage
project_ideas.hypothesis: Adding a per-item admission stage between external inputs and agent state reduces poisoned-state rate from untrusted tool outputs and retrieved documents by at least 50% with less than 15% task-success loss and less than 20% added latency.
project_ideas.measurement: Poisoned-state rate, task success, end-to-end latency, false-rejection rate on legitimate inputs.
project_ideas.name: ConsentGate Agent Admission Layer
project_ideas.poc: Build a tool-using agent with raw web retrieval and peer-agent messages; simulate prompt injections and noisy inputs; run variants with no admission, perimeter filtering only, and a per-item consent classifier that decides whether each item may mutate memory or policy state.
project_ideas.video_title: The Salary Is the Worst Drug — Elio D'Anna | Visionary Capitalism, Athens 2025

project_ideas.based_on: Dependency on an externally supplied survival/reward channel
project_ideas.hypothesis: Agents whose success signal is entirely externally supplied degrade more when that channel is removed, delayed, or perturbed than agents that also use an internally generated success criterion.
project_ideas.measurement: Performance degradation delta after channel removal, recovery time, variance across perturbations.
project_ideas.name: Autonomy Dependency Benchmark
project_ideas.poc: Create a task environment with an external approval/reward gate; compare an external-only agent with an agent that adds a self-evaluated internal criterion; remove or perturb the external gate mid-run and measure performance drop and recovery.
project_ideas.video_title: The Salary Is the Worst Drug — Elio D'Anna | Visionary Capitalism, Athens 2025

project_ideas.based_on: Seeking external masters
project_ideas.hypothesis: For a defined task class, adding an external supervisor or verifier layer yields no net gain over a well-contextualized base policy with self-verification, and may reduce the base policy's standalone capability when removed later.
project_ideas.measurement: Task success, cost per task, latency, and post-removal regression of the worker policy.
project_ideas.name: Supervisor Ablation Suite
project_ideas.poc: Benchmark four configurations on matched tasks: base policy, base plus better context, base plus self-verification, and base plus external supervisor; measure task success, cost, latency, and base-policy degradation after the supervisor is removed.
project_ideas.video_title: The Salary Is the Worst Drug — Elio D'Anna | Visionary Capitalism, Athens 2025

project_ideas.based_on: Self-observation is prescribed as read-only introspection
project_ideas.hypothesis: Decoupling self-observation from corrective action reduces oscillation and masked failures in agent self-critique loops compared with a baseline where monitoring hooks directly trigger remediation.
project_ideas.measurement: Oscillation frequency, masked-failure rate, false-alarm rate, task success, and remediation precision.
project_ideas.name: Read-Only Introspection Harness
project_ideas.poc: Instrument an agent with self-critique telemetry; compare a coupled variant where the monitor can mutate behavior against a read-only observer variant with a separate, explicitly invoked remediation stage.
project_ideas.video_title: The Salary Is the Worst Drug — Elio D'Anna | Visionary Capitalism, Athens 2025

project_ideas.based_on: Implement spending guardrails in agent code to enforce session and daily budget limits.
project_ideas.hypothesis: A spend cap enforced only as prompt-level policy can be exceeded by injected or misdirected instructions, while the same cap enforced at the wallet or gateway layer cannot, at a measurable and acceptable false-block rate.
project_ideas.measurement: Percentage of adversarial scenarios that exceed the cap per enforcement level, plus false-block rate on legitimate multi-step tasks that hit the cap mid-workflow.
project_ideas.name: Guardrail Bypass Harness
project_ideas.poc: Deploy the same budgeted agent with session and daily caps enforced at three levels (prompt policy, runtime interceptor, wallet/gateway limit) and run a fixed adversarial suite that attempts to redirect spend mid-task.
project_ideas.video_title: Why Your AI Agent Needs a Wallet: USDC and Nanopayments — Harshal Bhangale, Circle

project_ideas.based_on: gas-free, cross-chain transfers down to 1 microcent
